raw.description:
Job Description Summary

Sandoz is going through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. By creating a new and ambitious path, it will provide a unique opportunity for us all, both professionally and personally.

As the Global Marketing Automation Manager at Sandoz, you will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of marketing automation strategies and systems to enhance our digital marketing campaigns. You will be responsible for orchestrating personalized and data-driven marketing efforts to engage healthcare professionals, patients, and stakeholders on a global scale.

Job Description

Key responsibilities:

  • Marketing Automation Strategy:
    • Develop and execute a global marketing automation strategy aligned with the company's marketing objectives, ensuring efficient lead generation, nurturing, and conversion processes
  • Campaign Development and deployment
    • Collaborate with a Team of Global Digital Marketing Managers to design and execute automated customer journeys, ensuring relevance and effectiveness
    • Identify all touchpoints on identification and implementation new customer journey and provide clear interaction plans for multiple markets
  • Automation Platform Management
    • Oversee the implementation, and management of marketing automation platforms such as Scout (SFDC) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud
    • Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) is required, including Journey Builder, Audience Builder and Email Studio.
    • Work with MCM channel operations team to ensure effective and efficient use of global digital platforms including latest best practices, updates or releases including new functionalities and channels
  • Performance Analytics
    • Monitor and analyze marketing automation performance, providing insights and recommendations for optimization to enhance campaign effectiveness
  • Compliance and Data Privacy:
    • Ensure marketing automation activities adhere to pharmaceutical industry regulations, including data privacy (e.g., GDPR), and work closely with legal and regulatory teams.
  • Training and Support:
    • Provide training and support to marketing teams and stakeholders in using marketing automation tools effectively.

Our requirements:

  • Proven 3-5 years of experience in Marketing Automation area, (nice to have would be to have an experience within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry)
  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) is required; experience with Salesforce/CRM and other marketing automation tools is an advantage.
  • Strong digital background and successful track of digital initiatives with demonstrated business impact measured by organizational metrics.
  • Strong data analytics and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering personalized and data-driven marketing experiences.
  • Fluent English.
  • University degree (preferably in Marketing/Business/Economics or related).

Compensation Structure & Criteria:

Sandoz compensation is determined by job level, qualifications, niche skills, experience, and location within company salary ranges. Fully proficient and highly effective employees can expect a starting salary around market median, with those new to the level or with less functional depth at the lower end of the range and those with sustained superior or niche skills towards the higher end of the range. Internal equity and external market data inform our range placement. Annual salary reviews consider performance outcomes, market alignment, and business needs.


Job location: Warsaw, Poland (office)

Work mode: remote

Pay range (monthly salary): gross/zł 15 225- 28 275

Variable compensation:

-annual performance-based bonus: 15%

-employee share program;


Additional benefits include:

• Lunch card worth 450 zł per month

• Laptop,

• Medical care

• Life Insurance

• Retirement plan

• Multisport or Kultura + card (co-financed by the employee)

• Additional 2 days off

• Language learning platform

Pay frequency: monthly

Expected weekly working hours: 40h

Contract type: Replacement employment contract


Why Sandoz?

Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us!

Join our Sandoz Network: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to hear more about Sandoz and our career opportunities, join the Network here:

#Sandoz

Skills Desired

Digital Marketing, Marketing Strategy, Product Marketing, Product Strategy, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Partnerships

title: Senior End Users Remote Sales Representative I
description: 加入我们，成为高级终端用户远程销售代表，在舒适的远程工作空间中推动有意义的客户关系。你将使用数字工具和咨询式销售提供解决方案，帮助客户提升效率和可持续性，同时增加你所负责客户组合的收入。 你将做什么？ 通过虚拟会议、电话和数字互动策略建立和管理客户账户 应用咨询式销售技巧理解客户挑战并展示定制化解决方案 与现场销售团队合作，协调客户策略并最大化业务机会 管理从开发和需求生成到谈判和成交的完整销售周期 我们在寻找哪些关键技能？ 沟通能力 — 高级水平；通过虚拟渠道向不同利益相关者清晰阐述价值主张 谈判能力 — 高级水平；远程完成复杂交易的同时保持牢固的客户关系 客户管理 — 中级水平；优化客户组合并识别战略增长机会 咨询式销售 — 中级水平；发掘客户挑战并定位能推动业务成果的解决方案 客户关系管理 — 中级水平；利用CRM工具跟踪互动并培养长期合作关系 积极倾听 — 中级水平；通过虚拟对话深入理解客户需求 数据分析与解读 — 中级水平；运用洞察指导客户策略并确定行动优先级 产品知识 — 中级水平；自信地展示施耐德电气的完整产品组合以满足客户需求 什么资质会让你成功？ 战略思考者，能够在最少监督下识别和追求高影响力机会 强大的影响能力，能够在虚拟环境中建立信任并推动决策 团队合作者，能够跨职能和地域有效协作 自我驱动者，能够在远程环境中独立管理多项优先事项并取得成功 这对我有什么好处？ 远程工作，灵活管理你的时间安排并交付成果 利用一流的数字销售工具，这些工具专为最大化你的效能而设计 在致力于可持续发展和创新的全球领导者中发展你的职业生涯 通过帮助客户实现效率和可持续发展目标产生切实影响 准备好重新定义远程销售的成功了吗？立即申请并加入我们的团队！ 为您量身打造的回报 我们的全方位奖励体现了我们对您的重视。这不仅是薪酬和福利—it是对您的重要投资。该方案旨在支持您的表现、成长、安全感和潜能提升。它帮助您照顾自己和家人、规划未来、提升技能与职业发展、在包容的环境中协作，并为社区作出贡献。在施耐德电气，我们始终关注对您最重要的事情。欢迎访问我们的 职业发展页面 了解更多。 * 不同国家和地区可能适用不同的计划与项目。 你是否渴望让自己的职业生涯产生深远影响？ 当你考虑加入一个新团队时，企业文化至关重要。在施耐德电气，我们的价值观与行为准则是构建卓越文化、助力业务成功的基石。我们坚信，“IMPACT” 核心价值观—— 包容（Inclusion）、精进（Mastery）、使命（Purpose）、力行（Action）、求知（Curiosity）、共赢（Teamwork）—— 源于每一位成员的践行。 “IMPACT” 更是我们向你的诚挚邀约：无论你身处何种岗位，都能在施耐德电气将可持续发展的愿景转化为实际行动。这是一份号召，邀请你将个人职业发展与创造更具韧性、更高效率、更可持续的世界这一宏伟目标紧密相连。 我们正在寻找“影响力创造者”（IMPACT Makers）—— 那些能在自动化、电气化与数字化的交汇点，将可持续发展愿景转化为切实行动的杰出人才。我们推崇每一位“影响力创造者”，并相信每个人都有潜力成为其中一员。 加入施耐德电气，成为“影响力创造者”—— 即刻申请！ 全球营收达 400 亿欧元 有机增长率超 9% 业务遍及 100 多个国家和地区，员工超 15 万人 申请须知 所有岗位均需通过线上申请方可纳入考量。本岗位招聘将持续至合适人选到岗为止。 多元化与包容性承诺 施耐德电气致力于成为全球最具包容性与人文关怀的企业，我们为世界各地的每一个人提供公平的机会，确保所有员工都能感受到独特的价值认同，在安全的环境中全力以赴、贡献所长。我们珍视并反映所运营社区的多元性，“包容” 是我们的核心价值观之一。我们坚信，个体的差异能让企业与个人变得更加强大，我们承诺在一切工作中积极倡导包容性。 道德与合规准则 在施耐德电气，我们坚守最高标准的道德与合规要求，并坚信信任是核心价值基石。《信任宪章》（Trust Charter）是我们的行为准则，彰显了我们在道德、安全、可持续发展、质量及网络安全方面的坚定承诺，为我们业务的方方面面提供支撑，也体现了我们尊重他人、真诚对待所有利益相关方的意愿。你可通过此处了解更多关于《信任宪章》的信息。 平等就业机会声明 施耐德电气是一家倡导平等就业机会的雇主。我们的政策是，在招聘、录用、培训、调动及晋升等各个环节，为所有符合条件的个人提供平等的就业及发展机会，不因种族、宗教、肤色、性别、残疾、国籍、血统、年龄、军籍、性取向、婚姻状况或任何其他受法律保护的特征或行为而产生歧视。

raw.title: Credit Data Assurance Analyst
raw.excerpt: Overview This is a remote role that will be hired in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.
raw.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that will be hired in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.

This position serves as a strategic partner across Credit, Reporting, Data, Product, and Technology organizations, ensuring business, data, process, and system changes are effectively assessed for impacts to Credit Reporting and downstream reporting deliverables.

This role is responsible for performing complex business and data impact assessments, translating business requirements into actionable data use cases, leading data triage, and root cause analysis efforts, and driving improvements in data quality, data lineage transparency, and reporting readiness. The analyst will play a critical role in proactively identifying and mitigating reporting and data risks.

The successful candidate will possess strong credit domain expertise, advanced analytical skills, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across multiple organizations while independently leading strategic initiatives.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

Credit Reporting Impact Assessment

  • Perform portfolio-level impact assessments to identify reporting, data, and operational risks before implementation.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to ensure reporting requirements are understood and incorporated into change initiatives.

Business & Data Requirements Management

  • Translate business requirements into credit data use cases and actionable requirements for Product, Technology, and Data teams.
  • Develop business process maps, data flow documentation, and reporting requirements to support strategic initiatives.
  • Act as a liaison between business users and technical teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.

Data Analysis & Data Assurance

  • Perform advanced analysis of credit and reporting data to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve transparency into data quality, data lineage, controls, and reporting readiness across the Credit Reporting ecosystem.
  • Support the design and implementation of processes that enhance data reliability and consumption confidence.

Data Triage & Issue Management

  • Lead data triage activities, root cause analysis, and issue prioritization across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Coordinate the resolution of data quality, reporting, and operational issues by partnering with business, technology, and data teams.
  • Escalate and communicate material risks and issues to senior stakeholders as appropriate.

Reporting Risk Management

  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate reporting and data risks before they impact downstream consumers or regulatory deliverables.
  • Evaluate control effectiveness and recommend enhancements that strengthen reporting accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Support governance and risk management activities related to Credit Reporting and data management.

Strategic Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Independently lead cross-functional initiatives involving Credit, Reporting, Technology, Product, and Data organizations.
  • Influence decision-making by translating complex credit concepts into measurable business and data impacts.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on Credit Reporting, data risk, and reporting readiness matters.

Position Specific Skills:

  • Commercial Banking or Lending Operations Experience
  • Data Quality Management & Data Lineage
  • Cross-Functional Partnership & Collaboration
  • Data Analysis
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Risk Identification & Mitigation

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 4 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 8 years' experience in Analytics, or Modeling, or Reporting

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience assessing the impact of data, process, system, or business changes on reporting and regulatory deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of commercial lending, credit products, and the end-to-end credit lifecycle.
  • Experience with data lineage, data governance, data quality, and controls frameworks.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience analyzing large, complex datasets.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and leading issue remediation efforts.
  • Knowledge of regulatory reporting, reporting controls, or enterprise risk management practices.
  • Experience working across Credit, Technology, Data, and Reporting organizations.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data transformation, modernization, or credit data initiatives.

Additional Information

This job posting is expected to remain active for 5 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants.

The base pay for this position is generally between $95,000 and $115,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at .

U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

This job requires a U.S. Person. A U.S. Person is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, or individuals granted refugee or asylee status in the U.S. are considered U.S. persons. For a complete definition of “U.S. Person” go here.

Security Clearance Type:

Required

Security Clearance Status:

Not Required

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

As an Account Specialist supporting the MESPC value stream, you will play a critical role in managing supplier relationships and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products. You will lead cross-functional teams, manage supplier performance, and oversee the qualification and delivery of parts. Key responsibilities include:

  • Manage complex cold start product procurement and supplier relationships.
  • Oversee supplier monthly spares output to ensure timely and quality delivery.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to qualify parts and ensure timely delivery.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to address and resolve quality or delivery issues.
  • Monitor and manage supplier performance metrics, including cost, quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and procedures.
  • Support strategic sourcing initiatives in alignment with long-term business objectives.
  • Identify and mitigate risks related to supplier performance and delivery schedules.

Qualifications You Must Have

  • A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years experience
  • U.S. Person - Job requires access to ITAR or 600/500-series EAR information or hardware (directly or indirectly) and the company will not seek an export authorization for this role.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience in supply chain management, including procurement and supplier management.
  • Experience with project management processes and tools.
  • Experience managing supplier performance, including quality and delivery metrics.
  • 3 years of experience in procurement.

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:


Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a degree of onsite presence associated with this role.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 86,800 USD - 165,200 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

raw.excerpt: Peraton OverviewPeraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Security Administrator with a primary focus on security administration, audit support, policy management, and third-party risk oversight to maintain a continuous compliance posture against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA, and related frameworks.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong project management skills, audit experience, and the ability to manage multiple security and compliance workstreams while supporting security leadership, privacy stakeholders, vendors, on-site security engineering teams, and independent assessment organizations.

This selected individual will support our SafeGuard Services (SGS) team, a subsidiary of Peraton, which performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review, to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare/Medicaid healthcare programs.

What you'll do:

The Security Administrator will be responsible for the following but not limited to::

Security Compliance & Policy Management

  • Author, maintain, and update security policies, procedures, standards, plans, and control documentation for the SGS Contracts environment.
  • Perform control testing and gap analysis against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA/HITECH and the CMS ARS and PIM.
  • Document deficiencies and manage the Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) lifecycle from identification through verified closure
  • Respond to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEVs), CCIC bulletins, and compliance data calls

Audit & Assessment Support

  • Support maintenance of the control evidence library and GRC platform records, control mappings, and compliance reporting using CFACTs.
  • Serve as the operational-side evidence provider for annual independent assessments and CMS reviews.
  • Support Security Assessment preparation and security assessment report development
  • Ensure audit-readiness on any given day rather than reconstructed compliance

Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management

  • Conduct vendor security due diligence and assessments.
  • Perform contract and control reviews, continuous monitoring, and risk reporting
  • Manage vendor security questionnaires and ongoing compliance verification

Security Management & Monitoring (SMM) Administration

  • Administer SMM platform documentation, audit activities, and training programs
  • Serve as application owner liaison or support PMO coordination for SMM-related activities
  • Support application ID administration and controls

Physical Security & Access Control

  • Generate and audit Lenel access control reports on a weekly and monthly basis
  • Conduct group audits and access reviews.
  • Support training and onboarding activities

Program & Administrative Support

  • Leverage SharePoint and PowerApps knowledge to streamline workflows and reporting
  • Participate and support change control boards; evaluate applications; participate in technical solutioning and evaluation
  • Support program operations which may include and is not limited to; leading small projects and initiatives, supporting business capture and growth, and providing cross functional support
  • Telework available from EST, MST or CST.time zones.

Qualifications

Basic qualifications:

  • 2 years with BS/BA or 6 years with a HS diploma/equivalent
  • Security Administration experience and the ability to work flexible hours.
  • Experience in security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), third-party risk management, audit support, and data protection.
  • Experience performing control assessment and gap analysis against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, and managing the POA&M lifecycle
  • Vendor and Application security risk management experience.
  • Authoring ability for policies, control narratives, and deficiency documentation that withstands external review.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration abilities.
  • US. citizenship required.

Desired qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering
  • Healthcare Compliance: Working knowledge of HIPAA/HITECH.
  • CMS: Experience with CMS requirements and Authority to Connect/Operate support, including Security Assessment Workbooks (SAWs), security assessment reports, and control evidence packages
  • State & Federal Government: Experience in government regulated compliance environments
  • Technical Skills: Experience with SharePoint administration, and PowerApps development
  • Incident Response: Hands-on incident response experience in regulated environments
  • Verified Experience: Preference for candidates with verified work experience over recent college graduates
  • Emerging technologies: Artificial intelligence (AI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Large Language Models (LLM)

Target Salary Range

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

JOB SUMMARY: The Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Manager will provide advanced financial leadership, reporting, analysis, and strategic partnerships to the assigned Division or business segment. This highly visible role collaborates closely with senior Finance and Operational leaders, driving comprehensive financial planning initiatives and championing data-driven insights for strategic decision making. The Senior FP&A Manager is responsible for leading complex strategic finance projects, mentoring team members, setting best practices in financial modeling and analysis, and serving as a trusted advisor in supporting business objectives and growth strategies—including those related to acquisitions and continuous process improvement.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

  • Serve as a financial thought leader, developing strong partnerships with leadership and cross-functional business partners at WCG.
  • Lead preparation, consolidation, and presentation of financial performance reports, forecasts, and strategic analyses for assigned business units.
  • Oversee and continuously improve financial planning processes, reporting automation, and metric dashboards to deliver actionable insights to executive management.
  • Direct and facilitate quarterly and annual business reviews, including in-depth variance analysis, business drivers, and recommended action plans.
  • Guide the development, maintenance, and accuracy of advanced headcount and resource planning models, including internal labor, contractors, and capex/opex spending.
  • Lead the preparation and review of comprehensive ROI analyses for projects.
  • Support corporate M&A activities by providing financial insight, due diligence support, and integration planning as required.
  • Mentor or coach analysts and finance managers as the team scales or as project needs dictate.
  • Represent finance in cross-functional strategic projects and initiatives; support or lead others through formal project management.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, best practices, and regulatory requirements impacting financial planning and analysis.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, concentration in Finance or Accounting.

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • None

QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:

  • Exceptional Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Proven experience in leveraging financial reporting systems, preferably NetSuite and Workday Adaptive Insights. Experience developing and maintaining PowerBI dashboards highly recommended.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in detailed budgeting and forecasting, financial modeling, financial reporting, and KPI & dashboard reporting. Must be able to rapidly assimilate financial data from disparate systems and databases to produce timely, accurate, and executive-level reporting and analysis.
  • Must be comfortable building processes and looking for solutions to scale the organization and drive efficiencies. Must be comfortable in an acquisitive / M&A environment with continual additions and change.
  • Quick learner who is outcome focused, with a strong sense of urgency and instincts to “go the extra mile.” Must thrive in high pressure, deadline-oriented, dynamic environments.
  • Experience leading and managing project teams to completion while also being hands-on.
  • Must have strong interpersonal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow established policies as well as effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must be able to influence decisions through clear, data-driven analysis and cogent presentation.
  • Experience presenting financial information to groups, including executive level.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

You will play a pivotal role in integrating our HealthRules software suite with client systems, optimizing workflows, and implementing AI-driven solutions where appropriate.

This role is highly technical and requires hands-on experience with Java/J2EE, integration frameworks, testing, deployment pipelines, and enterprise systems. You will also guide technical discussions, code reviews, and ensure high-quality delivery across the team.

About the Technology Team:Our Technology Team is a dynamic group of innovators reshaping the future of healthcare technology. This team thrives on collaboration, bringing together top talent from diverse backgrounds to create scalable, secure, and cutting-edge platforms. With expertise in cloud infrastructure, AI, and user experience design, they enable transformation for healthcare health plan solutions. Beyond technical excellence, the HealthEdge Technology Team is passionate about empowering clients. They prioritize transparency, thoughtful resource allocation, and a commitment to seamless experiences. Guided by visionary leadership and a deep enthusiasm for innovation, this group is redefining what’s possible in healthcare technology.

Your Impact:• Design, develop, and deploy scalable, enterprise-grade Java applications, leveraging SOA, EAI, and microservices architectures.• Lead solution architecture discussions, design whiteboarding, and technical planning sessions.• Mentor junior engineers and lead peer code reviews, enforcing best practices for maintainable and high-quality software.• Develop unit tests (JUnit, TestNG), integration tests, and automated deployment pipelines for production-ready code.• Work with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Maven, Git) to streamline builds, deployments, and testing automation.• Handle complex data integration, migration, and transformation tasks, ensuring data consistency and reliability.• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful UAT, production deployments, and client issue resolution.• Apply AI/ML techniques, automation, and intelligent algorithms to enhance business processes, predictive analytics, and workflow optimization where applicable.• Lead the implementation of integration frameworks, web services, and messaging solutions (JMS, SOAP/REST, ESB technologies).• Support ongoing production and non-production system maintenance, including database tuning, performance optimization, and troubleshooting.

What You Bring:• BS/BA in Computer Science or related field; advanced degrees a plus.• Minimum 7 years of professional experience in Java/J2EE development, system integration, and enterprise application design.• Expertise in Core Java, XML, Web Services, JMS, SQL, Linux, Tomcat, Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloud technologies.• Hands-on experience with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, TestNG), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins), Git/Bitbucket, and Maven.• Familiarity with integration middleware / ESB technologies (iWay, Apache Camel, Spring Integration) and OSGi containers (Apache Karaf).• Strong understanding of design patterns, enterprise integration patterns, and scalable software architectures.• Experience leading technical design discussions, performing code reviews, and mentoring junior engineers.• Prior experience in the healthcare or health insurance (payor) domain preferred.• Agile development experience (SCRUM, Kanban) and ability to work across distributed teams.• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with a focus on client-facing engagements.

Bonus points:• Exposure to AI/ML technologies or automation frameworks for enterprise software solutions.• Experience with performance tuning of Java applications and database queries.• Experience with Web Service testing tools (SOAPUI, Postman).• Hands-on experience with cloud deployments (AWS, Azure) and containerized microservices.

We aspire to be a place where all employees have the opportunity to belong, make an impact and deliver excellent software and services to our customers.

*Note this role requires proof of US residency for the last consecutive 5 years*

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

Lidera la transformación digital de procesos como Pega Business Analyst

En Initium Software conectamos al mejor talento técnico con los proyectos más desafiantes e innovadores del mercado. No somos una consultora tradicional; somos socios estratégicos que creemos en el impacto real a través de la tecnología. Buscamos a un Pega Business Analyst con visión estratégica y rigor técnico para liderar la definición de procesos de negocio y la elaboración de requerimientos en aplicaciones de clase empresarial.

Tus desafíos y responsabilidades

    • Liderar sesiones de descubrimiento y toma de requerimientos con stakeholders de negocio desde las fases de Discovery hasta Elaboration.
    • Traducir necesidades complejas de negocio en artefactos de diseño Pega, historias de usuario detalladas y criterios de aceptación precisos.
    • Colaborar con diseñadores de experiencia de usuario para alinear los requerimientos funcionales con los principios de diseño de Pega Constellation.
    • Trabajar conjuntamente con arquitectos y desarrolladores Pega para garantizar la viabilidad técnica y el máximo aprovechamiento de la plataforma.
    • Gestionar y priorizar el backlog del producto en entornos Agile/Scrum, además de coordinar el soporte a las pruebas de aceptación de usuario (UAT) y el triaje de incidencias.

    ¿Qué buscamos en ti?

    • Experiencia mínima de 5 años demostrable desempeñando el rol de Pega Business Analyst.
    • Certificación Pega Certified Business Architect (PCBA) en versión 8.X.
    • Profundo entendimiento del ciclo de vida de casos (Pega Case Lifecycle), modelado de datos y capacidades de integración en Pega.
    • Manejo de herramientas de modelado y gestión como Blueprint, Visio, JIRA y Confluence en metodologías ágiles.
    • Nivel avanzado de inglés (C1) y español fluido, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y gestión de interesados.

    Valoramos especialmente si además

    • Aportas experiencia previa en proyectos dentro del sector asegurador (Insurance).
    • Te apasiona aprender, compartir ideas y evolucionar junto al equipo.

    ¿Cómo mediremos tu impacto?

    • Cumplimiento mensual de objetivos de eficiencia de Proyectos.
    • Alineación y ejecución efectiva del plan estratégico.

    ¿Qué te ofrecemos?

    • Modalidad 100% remota con base en España, fomentando la autonomía y el equilibrio profesional y personal.
    • Participación en proyectos internacionales de gran escala con arquitecturas modernas.
    • Cultura abierta, transparente y orientada al desarrollo continuo del talento tecnológico.

En Initium no solo desarrollamos tecnología: creamos un entorno donde las personas pueden evolucionar, aportar valor y dejar huella.

Aplica ahora y hablemos.

Overview

Overview:

The Business Consultant leads and mentors the Service Delivery team in all Tier 1 (Basic) and Tier 2 (Intermediate) consulting initiatives. The position provides in-depth and comprehensive subject matter expertise related to Burgess products (from basic to advanced features/functionality), payment methodologies/policies (Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial), payment integrity, and healthcare plan operations (e.g., claim life cycle/workflow, network contracting, payment/policy configuration, provider relations, medical management, medical economics, audit, compliance) related to implementation/consulting engagements, strategic user adoption initiatives, and ongoing client support.

What you will do:

Education and Consulting (implementation/consulting engagements, strategic user adoption initiatives, and on-going client support)

  • Provide the highest level of product education (from basic to advanced features/functionality to Burgess end-users
  • Provide in-depth and comprehensive subject matter expertise related to:
  • Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payment methodologies/policies
  • Payment integrity
  • Healthcare plan operations (e.g., claim adjudication life cycle/workflows, network contracting, payment/policy related configuration, provider relations, medical management, medical economics, audit, compliance)
  • Conduct collaborative scoping sessions to identify client needs and appropriate solutions
  • Actively manage and/or participate in the development, maintenance, and execution of client facing education services 

 

Enhancement/Issue Escalation

  • Manage issues, questions, inquiries of Tier 1 and 2 escalation
  • Serve as escalation point for critical client needs as warranted.
  • Lead diagnosis and resolution of escalated and more involved/complex client problems and issues.
  • Act as a liaison between clients and internal support staff (research, development, and product teams) to assure accurate problem interpretation and resolution.
  • Capture and solicit issues/feedback from clients and internal stakeholders and document issues and client impacts.
  • Partner with appropriate Burgess Teams (BA, PM, Development, Account Management, Sales/Business Development, Product, Content, and Service Delivery) to manage problem framing, diagnosis and resolution.
  • Conduct/participate in root cause analysis to identify and deliver warranted service improvements.
  • Maintain demeanor as a calming influence during pressure situations, mixing in the correct degree of professional assertiveness without becoming aggressive.
  • Maintain communication with customers during the problem resolution process, utilizing superior customer service skills.

 

Capability/Tool Development/Maintenance

  • Leverage capabilities and tools (knowledge libraries, workflow, issue identification and documentation, function processes).
  • Lead capability and tool development under direction of Service Delivery Leadership.

 

Staff/Team Management/Supervision

  • Mentor and provide oversight for Tier 1 and 2 Service Delivery staff
  • Take direction from and collaborate with Service Delivery Leadership to continually review and enhance performance and strategy.

 

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business, health services administration, mathematics, science or related field, and/or equivalent work experience required.
  • AHIP, HFMA, AAPC, and/or AHIMA certification preferred.
  • 5+ years training, education, and/or consulting experience preferred.
  • Practical understanding of the healthcare system with regards to Medicare, Medicaid, managed care, and commercial payment methodologies, payment integrity, and health plan operations (e.g., claim life cycle/workflows, network contracting, payment/policy related configuration, provider relations, medical management, medical economics, audit, compliance).
  • Experience with interpretation/translation of complex health-plan in-network and out-of-network provider rate and/or claim editing provisions.
  • Experience with configuration and maintenance of provider rate and/or claim editing provisions in a claims adjudication system and/or third-party vendor application.
  • Working knowledge of claim billing specifications (e.g., CMS-1500, UB-04, 837, HIPAA code sets).
  • Creative problem-solving skills including the ability to identify, recommend, and implement strategic solutions.
  • Ability to manage issues, requests, problems, and situations of all Tier 1 and 2 escalation levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct education/training sessions to large audiences across multiple skill levels.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems.
  • Ability to adapt to a changing and rapidly growing environment.
  • Effectively manage multiple priorities and follow through on all projects to completion.

 

Who You Are:

  • Creative entrepreneur. You have a constant drive to make things better; you question the status quo and approach common challenges with creativity and constructive criticism. You have skills to clearly and convincingly share ideas in a way that adapts to your audience, regardless of function, level, or expertise.
  • Critical, big-picture thinker. You have a constant thirst for knowledge and the ability to credibly share it with others, whether internally or externally. You are analytical, evaluating logic-based details while always considering and problem solving for the sake of the big picture.
  • Self-starter. You are proactive, self-motivated, and able to push work, start initiatives, and provide ideas independently in a team environment.
  • Team player & coach. You can foster professional and personal respect from others and find success in a team setting. While highly collaborative, you have natural management skills and know how to grow and develop people.
  • Adaptable multi-tasker. You are highly organized and flexible. You know how to manage expectations and are able to thrive in fast-paced, constantly changing environments and successfully adapt to a variety of tasks.

 

How We Work:

  • Collaborative. We work together and help each other do our best by building on our work across teams and offices. We don’t own individual ideas or seek credit.
  • User-driven. We place our clients and our users’ needs above all else. If it matters to a user, it matters to us. We work for them and keep ourselves accountable to that.
  • Hands-on. We don’t wait for problems to solve themselves. We enter the thick of it and get things done.
  • Impact over ego. Our culture is about results, not ownership. Great ideas have seniority over titles and levels, and great thinkers outshine fancy pedigrees.
  • Forward-looking. We look beyond our own world to constantly improve our business. We welcome outside speakers, tap into the latest tech, and make sure we’re future proof in anticipation of what’s coming next.
  • Caring & close knit. We know and care about our people. We know each other’s project strengths—but also about upcoming family trips and favorite after work drinks

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $90,000 to $120,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

This is a remote position.

Business Operations Manager
Remote (India) | Full-time
Also searched as: Operations Manager, Business Operations Lead, PMO Manager, Project Operations Manager, Shared Services Manager, GCC Operations Manager.
Could you lead ops coordinators, project managers and service teams while carrying real projects alongside them?
On a typical day you might run the planning call for a cross-team project you are leading, review a dashboard showing which requests are running late, sit with a pod lead to rebuild an estimate that looks twice as long as the last similar job, and agree with the Internal Product team which manual handoff to automate next.
About Contour

We operate across three brands. The India team, part of the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building. It runs delivery, automation, people and operations for the whole organisation, working closely with teams in Australia.
The kind of people who thrive here
Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on. Today we are about 600 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.
The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. People who do well here care about that.
They own their work end to end, start things without being asked and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, write decisions down and give direct feedback. The pace is fast: small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle. Growth follows what you deliver: scope, title and pay move with the bar you raise.
About this role
You lead Operations in Contour's India team: several teams brought together under one player-coach. Your team includes Contour’s operations coordinators, who keep academics, campus, finance and the founder’s office running day to day, and its project coordinators and managers, who run cross-team work across the business. It also covers organisation services such as print operations, procurement and workspace systems.
Each service has two sides. In Australia, a functional owner, such as Finance or Academics, sets its standards and priorities. In India, you run the work: coordinators and project managers report to you directly, and any service big enough for its own pod lead reports through them. Everything else is yours: how work comes in, how it is planned, checked and automated, and how the people doing it grow.
Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you learn each service's workflow well enough to coach its lead, inspect what it produces and challenge its estimates, and you know where your knowledge stops: on professional questions, you rely on the specialists. Second, you make different services run as one, with a shared way of taking requests, planning capacity and checking work, so the rest of Contour deals with one group rather than a row of separate desks.
This is a player-coach seat, and we mean it. Expect a real share of most weeks to go on doing the work yourself: running a cross-team project end to end, taking the coordination nobody else can untangle, checking a sample of finished work, mapping a process that keeps stalling or rebuilding an estimate from the ground up. The rest goes on making your coordinators, project managers and pod leads better at the same work. You won't be the specialist in every service, but you can work inside each one's workflow, and your team sees you do it. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast. The intake, planning, quality and automation routines you set now are what every later service joins.

What you will do

  • Run work yourself:lead some cross-team projects and coordination directly, especially the messy ones, so you know first-hand what your team is up against.
  • Lead the coordinators and project managers:set how projects and department requests are scoped, tracked and closed, review their plans and status updates, and step in when work slips.
  • Map every service's workflow with the people who run it and document it in Notionso anyone can follow it.
  • Run one front door for requests:a single intake form with clear turnaround times, so the rest of Contour deals with one group.
  • Plan capacity weeklyusing live dashboards of demand, turnaround and backlog, not gut feel.
  • Automate the repeatable:spot manual handoffs, data entry and status chasing, and work with the Internal Product team to automate them (for example with Monday, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace or no-code tools).
  • Use AI where it saves time:first-pass quality checks, drafting SOPs, summarising requests, with people keeping the final call.
  • Inspect quality:review samples of finished work against each owner's standard and fix repeat faults at the source.
  • Challenge estimatesagainst past jobs before they reach the business, and agree any change with whoever owns the work.
  • Keep functional owners informedon demand, risk and capacity, and turn their priorities into your team's plan.
  • Coach directly:structured 1:1s and performance conversations with your reports. Help any pod leads do the same, and make sure everyone knows who relies on their work.
  • Grow the group:build the case when a service needs a hire, a tool or a better process. Hiring goes ahead once the owner confirms approved headcount and budget. Bring a new service into the group only when it fits the pooled model.

Requirements

What you need
We weigh what you have built and run more than years on a CV. You should be able to point to:
  • Teams from more than one discipline that you led and answered for, including one outside your own field.
  • Projects you ran end to end while leading a team.
  • Aworkflow you mapped and rebuilt with the people who run it, which they still use.
  • A manual process you automated or moved onto a tool, with time saved or errors cut.
  • A dashboard or report you built that people used to make decisions.
  • An estimate or plan you pushed back on with evidence, and what changed.
  • People you managed directly, including coordinators or project managers and leads of their own teams.
Comfortable with workflow tools (Monday, Notion, Jira or similar), spreadsheets and dashboards, and curious about AI and no-code tools. You don't need to be an engineer.
If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy hands-on work, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.
Nice to have
  • Shared services, a GCC or a team serving colleagues in another country.
  • Education or a student-facing business.
  • Hands-on time with automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n or Apps Script) or process methods such as Lean.
What good looks like after 6 months
  • One front door:anyone at Contour knows how to ask for work and when they will hear back.
  • Dates that hold:the dates your teams give are the dates work lands.
  • Projects that land:cross-team projects run by your group finish on the dates and scope agreed.
  • Less manual work:the top repeat handoffs in your group are automated or removed.
  • Leads who decide:your coordinators and pod leads make daily calls without waiting for you.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, working across the India and Australia time difference. Pay is benchmarked to the role and discussed openly early in the process.
​
Ready to lead from the front: run the work, coach the people and automate what slows them down? Apply.

Epic Cadence Application Analyst, Remote Eligible, Jacksonville, Baptist Health Digital Solutions Center

Epic Cadence Application Analyst to support, maintain, and optimize critical patient access and scheduling applications across the organization. Serving as a vital liaison between clinical operations, patient access teams, and Information Technology, this role ensures Epic applications effectively support operational workflows, enhance efficiency, and deliver a seamless experience for patients, providers, and staff. Responsibilities also include implementing and validating Epic quarterly updates, collaborating with Epic technical support and internal application teams, and evaluating workflows to proactively identify and resolve potential disruptions. Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Iceland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Us:Comfrt LLC is the fastest growing ecommerce brand built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle, we are obsessed with our customer and dedicated to building the ultimate comfort brand ecosystem.

About the Job:We are seeking an experienced Merchandise Coordinator to manage day-to-day purchase order entry, SKU creation, and product data maintenance while supporting reporting and process improvement. Reporting to the Merchandising Operations Manager, this role maintains clean, reliable data across systems, keeps orders current, and follows through on cross-functional deadlines.
The coordinator works closely with Merchandising, Product, Sourcing, Production, Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, and eCommerce. The ideal candidate brings at least 4 years of relevant experience, is comfortable working with large datasets, and communicates proactively. They take ownership of established workflows, resolve routine discrepancies, and escalate issues requiring decisions or approval.

Responsibilities:

Purchase Order Entry and Coordination

  • Enter purchase orders in Fulfill or the designated order management system using approved buy information and confirmed vendor details.
  • Meet PO entry and issuance deadlines, proactively coordinating required inputs and approvals and escalating delays to keep orders on schedule.
  • Process approved PO revisions and delivery updates, maintain change records, and share updated information with relevant teams.
  • Check style numbers, SKUs, size and color breakdowns, quantities, costs, vendor codes, and delivery dates against approved source documents; flag missing or conflicting information before entry.
  • Coordinate with Product, Sourcing, and Production to obtain required inputs and approvals; follow established PO handoff and distribution procedures.
  • Keep open order trackers current, follow up on outstanding information, and escalate delays or discrepancies to the manager.
  • Support reconciliation of ordered, shipped, and received quantities with Supply Chain and Operations; document discrepancies for resolution.

SKU Creation and Integrity

  • Create and maintain SKUs for approved styles, colors, and sizes following established naming conventions and setup procedures.
  • Maintain product attributes and SKU mappings across product records, purchase orders, and operational systems; check for duplicates, missing fields, and inconsistencies.
  • Work with Operations to verify SKU information supports accurate inventory tracking, receiving, and fulfillment.
  • Partner with eCommerce to verify SKUs transfer accurately to the website and map to the correct product variants.
  • Maintain traceability across SKU records, POs, inventory, and website listings; flag mapping issues and support corrections with manager guidance.

Cross Functional Communication and Follow Up

  • Maintain clear, timely communication with cross-functional partners about PO status, SKU setup, missing inputs, and upcoming deadlines.
  • Track outstanding requests, follow up proactively, and communicate blockers early with the information needed to resolve them.
  • Document decisions and approved changes so teams work from current information; escalate questions requiring approval to the appropriate owner.

Reporting and Process Support

  • Maintain PO, SKU readiness, and product data trackers, reports, and dashboards that support merchandising, product development, and operational decisions.
  • Compile, validate, and review order, inventory, and sales data to highlight trends, exceptions, and discrepancies; support inventory planning, product performance reviews, and operational KPIs under the manager’s direction.
  • Identify recurring data quality issues and partner with the manager and cross-functional teams to improve workflows and prevent errors.
  • Document data workflows, reporting logic, and system procedures; help streamline or automate recurring reporting where practical.
  • Support system updates and ERP or PLM implementation activities through data cleanup, record validation, testing, and training as directed.
  • Participate in regular coaching and training to strengthen system knowledge, communication, and independent execution.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in merchandising operations, product operations, purchasing, supply chain coordination, or operational data management.
  • Hands-on experience with PO entry and ongoing management, SKU creation, and product master data integrity.
  • Strong Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience identifying data discrepancies and maintaining accurate operational reporting.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines while maintaining accuracy.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, proactive follow-up, and a collaborative approach to working across teams.
  • Ability to follow approval processes, recognize discrepancies, and escalate issues promptly.
  • Receptiveness to feedback, willingness to learn new systems, and consistent follow-through on assigned work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Merchandising, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • A creative problem solver. You enjoy improving products and processes.
  • Fast but disciplined. You know how to move quickly while maintaining high standards.
  • Accountable. You take ownership of your work and follow through.
  • Collaborative. You work well cross-functionally and communicate clearly with internal teams and vendors.
  • Comfortable in a high-growth environment. You thrive where expectations are high and priorities move quickly.

Nice to Have:

  • Apparel, home goods, retail, or e-commerce experience.
  • Familiarity with Fulfill, NetSuite, PLM, or other product, inventory, or purchase order management systems.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools; familiarity with workflow automation.
  • Hands-on experience with SKU mapping and reconciliation across ERP, PLM, inventory, and eCommerce systems.
  • Strong interest in matching and validating SKU records, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accurate, complete, and consistent information across systems.
  • Understanding of style, color, and size structures and how product data connects to inventory and website listings.
  • Basic knowledge of forecasting, inventory management, or S&OP processes.
  • Experience working in a remote or hybrid environment, with the professional judgment and accountability to work independently while staying highly collaborative and communicative.

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Inside Sales Executive to drive lead generation and business development activities for our AI, Data Analytics, and Digital Transformation services across the APAC region, primarily focusing on the Singapore market.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and reaching out to senior decision-makers, including C-level executives, IT Directors, CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Data, and other technology leaders within IT companies and enterprises.

The primary objective is to generate qualified business leads, initiate conversations with potential clients, qualify opportunities, and arrange meetings between prospective customers and our senior sales/business leadership team to explore potential AI and Data project opportunities.

The role will be performed remotely from an offshore location, requiring strong communication skills, confidence in engaging senior stakeholders, and the ability to build a consistent sales pipeline in the Singapore market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Generation & Prospect Identification

  • Identify potential customers, target companies, and business opportunities across Singapore and the wider APAC market.
  • Build and maintain a database of IT companies, enterprises, financial institutions, and other potential customers.
  • Research organisations to identify relevant decision-makers, including CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, IT Directors, and Heads of Data and Analytics.
  • Generate leads through LinkedIn, online research, company databases, networking platforms, and other prospecting channels.

2. Outbound Calling & C-Level Engagement

  • Conduct outbound cold calls and email campaigns to prospective customers.
  • Proactively reach out to C-level executives, business heads, IT leaders, and technology decision-makers.
  • Introduce our AI, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, and Digital Transformation capabilities.
  • Initiate meaningful business conversations and create interest in our technology services.
  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and identify potential business requirements.

3. Lead Qualification & Opportunity Identification

  • Understand the prospect's business challenges, technology landscape, and potential IT requirements.
  • Identify opportunities related to AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Cloud Data Platforms, and Digital Transformation.
  • Qualify leads based on business needs, project potential, budget, decision-making authority, and timelines.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, follow-ups, and lead status.

4. Meeting Arrangement & Sales Pipeline Development

  • Schedule qualified business meetings between prospective customers and the internal sales/business leadership team.
  • Ensure meetings are arranged with relevant decision-makers and stakeholders.
  • Share meeting briefs, prospect information, business requirements, and opportunity details with the internal team.
  • Conduct consistent follow-ups to convert initial conversations into meaningful business discussions.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified leads and sales opportunities.

5. Market Research & Reporting

  • Research the Singapore IT services market and identify potential business opportunities.
  • Track competitor activities, market trends, and emerging AI and Data technology requirements.
  • Provide regular reports on calls made, prospects contacted, leads generated, meetings arranged, and qualified opportunities.
  • Maintain CRM records and ensure timely follow-ups with prospects.

Target Audience

The candidate will primarily engage with:

  • CEOs, CIOs, CTOs and CDOs.
  • Chief Digital Officers and Chief Technology Officers.
  • IT Directors and Heads of Technology.
  • Heads of Data, Analytics and AI.
  • Heads of Enterprise Architecture and Digital Transformation.
  • Business Development and Technology Leaders.

Target Organisations: IT services companies, consulting firms, banks, financial institutions, insurance companies, fintech organisations, and large enterprises across Singapore and APAC.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Telecalling, Lead Generation, B2B Sales, or Business Development within the IT industry.
  • Proven experience in outbound calling, cold calling, and B2B prospecting.
  • Ability to confidently communicate with senior-level executives and C-level stakeholders.
  • Experience generating leads and arranging business meetings for IT services or technology solutions.
  • Good understanding of IT services, AI, Data Analytics, Cloud, and Digital Transformation concepts.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong research, prospecting, follow-up, and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM platforms, and lead-generation tools will be an advantage.
  • Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable working independently from an offshore location.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured based on:

  • Number of targeted companies and decision-makers identified.
  • Number of outbound calls and meaningful conversations.
  • Number of qualified leads generated.
  • Number of meetings successfully arranged with C-level and senior IT stakeholders.
  • Number of sales-qualified opportunities created.
  • Consistency of follow-ups and development of the sales pipeline.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is confident, persistent, and commercially driven, with the ability to pick up the phone, approach senior executives, open business conversations, and create opportunities from scratch.

The ideal candidate should have a strong hunter mindset, be comfortable with cold calling, and possess the confidence to engage decision-makers in Singapore-based IT companies and enterprises.

Success in this role is defined by the ability to generate quality leads, establish connections with senior decision-makers, and consistently arrange qualified business meetings that create opportunities for AI and Data projects.

Senior Director, Full-Service Sales

About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.

At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers.

About the role

The Senior Director, Full-Service Sales is a senior field leader responsible for the performance, talent, and strategic direction of a large, complex Full-Service region. This role leads a team of Full-Service Leaders to deliver sales growth, profitability, customer retention, and new business development while building organizational capability across the region.

The Senior Director operates as the regional general manager for Full Service—translating company strategy into regional execution, developing leadership bench strength, strengthening vendor and cross-functional partnerships, and driving consistent performance standards across multiple markets. In addition to owning regional results, the Senior Director is expected to influence the broader field organization through best-practice sharing, leadership of key initiatives, and contribution to organizational design, training, and talent planning.

Typical span of control: 6–8 Full-Service Leaders leading a large, multi-state region with elevated business, people, and market complexity.

Responsibilities

Grow the Business – 45%

  • Own the performance of a large Full-Service region, delivering against sales, gross margin, new customer acquisition, customer retention, productivity, and profitability targets.
  • Translate company strategy into a regional operating plan, including priorities by market, account segmentation, talent deployment, and focus areas for growth.
  • Lead through Full-Service Leaders to drive execution of sales plans, promotional priorities, key account strategies, and new business development across the region.
  • Review monthly and quarterly regional performance, identify performance gaps, and direct corrective action plans across territories and leaders.
  • Ensure regional forecasting accuracy through disciplined review of sales trends, pipeline opportunities, risks, and productivity indicators.
  • Coach Full-Service Leaders to use Salesforce, Tableau, and other business tools to identify opportunities related to customer growth, order trends, assortment gaps, event participation, returns, and vendor opportunities.
  • Serve as the senior regional partner for vendor/manufacturer relationships, including strategic market planning, education alignment, business development days, and key customer engagement.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders in stores, merchandising, supply chain, pricing, and finance to resolve issues, improve execution, and unlock growth.
  • Lead the regional business narrative for Quarterly Business Reviews, including performance, key risks, talent health, and recommended actions.

Lead the Team and Build Organizational Capability – 45%

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Full-Service Leaders, holding them accountable for territory performance, recruiting, onboarding, coaching, talent development, and execution consistency.
  • Build and maintain a strong regional leadership bench by identifying succession candidates, accelerating high-potential leaders, and addressing performance gaps decisively.
  • Own regional talent planning, including org design recommendations, territory leadership needs, and hiring plans in partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition.
  • Establish a consistent leadership operating rhythm across the region, including one-on-ones, performance reviews, field coaching, business reviews, and development planning.
  • Spend meaningful time in market with Full-Service Leaders to assess leadership effectiveness, coaching quality, customer engagement, and territory execution; provide direct feedback and action plans.
  • Drive accountability for associate experience, retention, engagement, and culture across the region.
  • Partner with Full-Service Leaders to address underperformance, performance management actions, and associate relations matters in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Lead onboarding and development standards for Full-Service Leaders across the region and contribute to broader field leadership training where appropriate.
  • Share best practices across regions and play an active role in shaping field leadership standards, role clarity, and productivity expectations.

Enterprise Leadership / Strategic Projects – 10%

  • Lead or contribute to enterprise and cross-regional initiatives such as organizational redesign, pilot execution, capability building, field training, productivity improvement, or vendor acceleration programs.
  • Provide input to the VP of Full-Service on organizational design, role effectiveness, regional coverage, talent moves, and long-term growth opportunities.
  • Model enterprise leadership by balancing regional priorities with broader company goals and acting as a visible culture leader across the Full-Service organization.

Knowledge, skills & abilities requirements

“The Company does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S.”

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.

  • 10+ years of progressive sales leadership experience, including multi-unit or field leadership responsibility.

  • Demonstrated success leading leaders and managing a complex, multi-state field sales organization.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret sales, margin, productivity, and customer data to drive action.

  • Experience building high-performing teams, coaching leaders, and managing performance.

  • Strong strategic thinking, planning, prioritization, and change leadership skills.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration, communication, and vendor partnership skills.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, Microsoft Office, and field productivity tools.

  • Beauty industry or adjacent B2B sales experience preferred.

  • Ability to travel overnight and weekends as business needs require.

Competencies & attributes

  • Strategic thinker with strong enterprise perspective
  • Talent builder and coach of leaders
  • Results-oriented with strong commercial and financial acumen
  • Change leader who can simplify complexity and drive adoption
  • Strong communicator and cross-functional partner
  • Decisive problem-solver with sound judgment
  • Customer- and field-focused operator
  • Inclusive leader who builds trust, accountability, and engagement

Working conditions & physical requirements

The work environment involves normal business travel and office/field conditions typical of meetings, stores, customer visits, and travel by automobile or air. The role requires regular travel across the assigned region and periodic overnight stays. Standard sedentary and mobile physical requirements apply, including driving, computer work, walking stores or salons, and attending meetings and events.
