raw.title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks) - Spain
raw.excerpt: At DATAPAO, data ignites passion, community fuels collaboration, and growth knows no bounds.
raw.description:
At DATAPAO, data ignites passion, community fuels collaboration, and growth knows no bounds. We are a leading Data Engineering and AI consulting company backed by Databricks and recognized for our unmatched delivery standards and rapid growth. We have been named Databricks EMEA Emerging Business Partner of the Year (2024), achieved the Golden Tier status in the Databricks Partner Program, and made three consecutive appearances on the Financial Times FT1000 list.

We are currently looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join us remotely in Spain. You will work with our EMEA and US customers to help them solve their data engineering, ML, ML Ops, and cloud migration puzzles.

"As a Data Engineer at DATAPAO, you will have the unique opportunity to push the boundaries of technology and lead the way in how data transforms the world. We work with customers who want to innovate and change their industries. So it never gets boring! Sorting out a complex technical puzzle, setting up a new data architecture from scratch, or guiding our customers through adopting the latest technologies is our routine here. Hence, we'd expect you to be more than just a (data) engineer. We'd expect you to breathe and live data, to thrive for knowledge and excellence, and to be keen to build something enduring and impactful for our customers. We'd expect you to be a (data) Paoneer!" (Máté Gulyás, CEO)

What will you do?

As a Senior Data Engineer, you are expected to deliver (across industries) on some of our most complex projects - individually or by leading small delivery teams. Although we work for the biggest multinational companies where years-long behemoth projects are the norm, our projects are fast-paced, typically 2 to 4 months long. Most are delivered using Apache Spark/Databricks on AWS/Azure and require you to directly manage the customer relationship alone or in collaboration with a Project Manager. Additionally, at this seniority level, we expect you to compound your impact across the team and the organization - by supporting our pre-sales process, mentoring more junior engineers, and contributing to hiring best-in-class data talent.

What does it take to fit the bill?

Technical Expertise

  • You (ideally) have 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a focus on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • You have a proven track record working with Databricks (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog);
  • You have extensive experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline orchestration (e.g., Databricks Workflows, DLT, Airflow, ADF, Glue, and Step Functions.);
  • You’re proficient in SQL and Python, using them to transform and optimize data like a pro;
  • You know your way around CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep);
  • You’ve hands-on experience integrating Databricks with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Consulting & Client-Facing Skills

  • Ideally, you bring a proven history in consulting, from scoping to gathering requirements, designing solutions, and communicating effectively with stakeholders. If you bring a product company background with you, that's also fine as long as you can show a good consulting mindset and desire to be customer-facing;
  • You’ve successfully delivered projects like Data Lakehouse buildouts and cloud data migrations;
  • You excel in explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences and drive decision-making.

Operational Readiness & Soft Skills

  • You’re (almost) ready to hit the ground running, immediately contributing to live client projects;
  • In a fast-paced consulting environment, where no two days are the same, flexibility and problem-solving comes naturally to you. Furthermore, resilience and thriving on challenges are essential traits in our industry;
  • Your communication skills are on point—whether you’re writing, speaking, or collaborating with stakeholders, you know how to keep everyone in the loop.

What do we offer?

You'll have the rare opportunity to join DATAPAO at a time when you can still meaningfully impact our growth trajectory and organizational success. Furthermore, as our first-ever Spain hire, you could meaningfully contribute to expanding our local presence and, eventually, establishing a physical hub in this geography.

Surely, we know everyone needs a little something to do their best work. Here is a list of some other extras we offer:

  • The chance to work remotely - as we don't have a physical office in Spain yet, we offer a fully remote setup for the time being. However, given our strong community emphasis, we'd expect you to spend one month in our Budapest hub during onboarding and visit the office for one week every quarter;

  • World-class educational benefits - there’s no shortage of learning opportunities at DATAPAO, meaning that you'll get access to Databricks' public and internal courses to learn all the tricks of Distributed Data Processing, MLOps, Apache Spark, Databricks, and Cloud Migration from the best. Additionally, we'll pay for various data & cloud certifications, you'll get dedicated time for learning during work hours, and access to our internal library;

  • Flexible PTO days - we’re flexible with how many days you take off if that does not conflict with customer success and the work getting done;

  • Fully paid Medical Leave for up to 15 days per year - because when you’re unwell, we want you to focus on recovery and not worry about your paycheck;

  • Comprehensive private health insurance plan via Allianz - offered via our EOR (Employer of Record) provider, Remote.com. Remote will be your official employer in Spain for the foreseeable future until we establish our own legal entity in Spain;

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) via Allianz & Remote - life always happens! And we'd like to be there for you when it counts the most. Through EAP, we offer our employees access to psychology, financial, and legal consulting services via phone or in person;

  • Top-notch working equipment - working comfortably means working well. You will get a MacBook Pro and a sign-up bonus of 500 EUR gross (to be paid with your first payroll) to set up your home office or whatever else is needed to give your best;

  • The chance to make an impact in a high-transparency culture - open feedback and no politics are things we value a lot at DATAPAO. Additionally, you'll get the chance to work in the field of data & AI and shape the future of a rapidly growing tech company.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Given that we are still sorting our way in Spain, this list will likely get an update in the following months, and we're also committed to growing it with us over time.

The gross salary for this position ranges from 70.000 to 80.000 EUR/year, depending on your assessed seniority level during the selection process.

Please note that currently we are unable to support transfer or offer full sponsorship for Skilled Worker visas as we’re just setting foot into Spain.

Want to know more about us?

DATAPAO is a Databricks Gold Partner covering the full data and AI journey — architecture, delivery, and enablement — for global brands that refuse to settle for "good enough." We don't hand over a slide deck and walk away: our engineers embed directly with client teams, and our training arm has turned 20,000+ professionals into Databricks experts worldwide.
We're backed by Databricks itself — the creators of Apache Spark — and act as their delivery and training partner across Europe. That partnership has earned us Databricks EMEA Emerging Partner of the Year, and a spot on the Financial Times FT1000 list of Europe's fastest-growing companies for the third year running (2026).
We've delivered 200+ projects for clients like Norsk-Hydro, Richter, Egis, Schufa, GetYourGuide, TechnoAlpin, and Logically, to name a few. As trainers, we've taught teams at NASDAQ, Imperial Brands, Accenture, Shell, UBS, Danske Bank, Pfizer, ASDA, Heineken, Hays, and Citigroup how to put data to work — not just talk about it.
Curious to see us in action? Check these out:
  • Databricks Data + AI Summit 2026: The Biggest Announcements Explained (EN) by Máté Gulyás
  • How Databricks Builds Production AI (EN) by Brooke Wenig, Head of AI FDE at Databricks — Data+AI Summit 2026
  • TechnoAlpin × Datapao: How TechnoAlpin Modernized Its Data Platform on Databricks — a client's take on working with us
You can also follow us on LinkedIn for all the good stuff, or just hit our recruitment team at
We're firm believers in scaling up a team without judgment or prejudice. What we really care about is working with the best people out there, no matter their background. And you should also not worry if you don't tick every box in the requirements. If you're passionate about data and learning new things, you'll fit right in, and we'd love to hear back from you.
When we hear back from you, we'd like you to know that we are committed to your privacy and keeping your data safe. We do not share your data with any third parties (except those we use to run our recruitment process) and retain your application for 2 years unless you ask us otherwise. We use your data solely for recruitment purposes, such as letting you know about new career opportunities at DATAPAO and/or managing your application. But if you want to know more about how we store and manage your data, check our privacy policy.

  • Familiarity with DoD RMF, STIGs, DISA security guidance, and security hardening activities.
  • ITIL Foundation, Security+, or comparable technical certification.
  • Experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery environments.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director, Product Management: Agentic Software Delivery, you'll own one of GitLab's most strategic sections, spanning Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability. You'll lead senior and principal product managers and be accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue across build, package, deploy, and monitor. Today, these are separate stages with a human making the call at each handoff. As agents take on more coding, pipeline, and deployment work, you'll set the three-year vision for how much of that judgment the system can make safely and how quickly a production signal can turn into a fix without waiting for a human to notice it first. You'll define how customers move from today's manual checkpoints toward agent-driven software delivery at a pace that fits their risk tolerance. In your first year, you'll bring four connected roadmaps into one coherent strategy, establish how investment is allocated and reallocated, deepen partnerships with Engineering and go-to-market leaders, and give customers a credible path for managing software delivery at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy, three-year vision, and business outcomes for GitLab's Agentic Software Delivery section, with a clear point of view on how artificial intelligence is changing software delivery.
  • Lead and develop senior and principal product managers across Continuous Integration, Artifact Management, Continuous Deployment, and Observability, helping them grow as independent decision-makers.
  • Establish the frameworks, standards, and operating rhythm that support consistent, high-quality product decisions without unnecessary escalation.
  • Own section-level key performance indicators and adoption funnels, using the results to reallocate investment or stop work that isn't paying off.
  • Evaluate major strategic bets, partnerships, and build, buy, or partner decisions, and develop the business cases that support them.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership on platform investment, architectural direction, and trade-offs across the section, while connecting build, package, deploy, and monitor into one coherent customer experience.
  • Drive pricing, packaging, go-to-market strategy, migration, and adoption with Product Marketing, Sales, Pricing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
  • Represent the section with GitLab's senior leadership, key enterprise customers, partners, and industry audiences, while modeling AI-native product management across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, roadmap exploration, and concept development.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience leading product managers, including developing senior and principal talent, hiring, and addressing performance directly.
  • A track record of owning a portfolio across multiple product areas and being accountable for adoption, retention, and revenue, not only roadmap delivery.
  • Product management depth in one or more relevant areas, such as continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, artifact or package management, release management, or observability.
  • Sound judgment about where to invest and where to stop, including experience making and defending build, buy, or partner decisions with a business case.
  • Technical fluency to work with engineers and architects on pipeline design, artifact workflows, deployment strategies, and observability signals such as logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Experience shaping pricing and packaging for technical products across free, commercial, and enterprise offerings.
  • Experience working with technical customers in developer tools, DevOps, or software delivery environments where engineers and engineering leaders are primary users.
  • Executive-level communication and influence.
  • Practical use of AI tools in product management workflows, along with a thoughtful view of how AI and agentic workflows are changing software delivery. We welcome candidates whose experience may come from different but transferable product and leadership paths.

About the team

The team brings together senior product leaders across GitLab's software delivery platform and works closely with Engineering, Design, and go-to-market partners so customers experience these capabilities as one connected system. The team helps customers manage today's delivery complexity while shaping how AI-powered and AI-native workflows influence the next generation of software delivery. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, the team collaborates asynchronously across regions with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.

The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About National Taxpayers Union Foundation

National Taxpayers Union Foundation is a non-partisan research and education organization dedicated to showing Americans how taxes, government spending, and regulations affect them. Through data collection, analysis, and commentary, we empower citizens to engage in the critical policy debates of our time and hold elected officials accountable. To educate our target audiences, we perform incisive research and analysis on a wide range of policy issues with a particular focus on tax, technology, interstate commerce, legislative scoring, and trade. We also have a newly launched public interest litigation project that has extended our work into the judicial sphere.

About the Role

Assist with NTUF research, analysis, and outreach efforts focused on budget and tax reform. Responsibilities include tracking and analyzing policy proposals and budget data, and contributing to issue briefs and other content for NTUF's website.

This role is open to remote or onsite candidates.

**Qualified candidates must submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and NTUF’s mission and may include this in the "Additional Information" field seen after clicking the "Apply for this Job" button.**

Candidates may also be asked to engage with NTUF's other projects, including:

  • Taxpayers’ Budget Office: Support efforts to improve fiscal transparency, strengthen cost estimates, eliminate budget gimmicks, reduce wasteful spending, and expose costly government perks.
  • Free Trade Initiative: Support initiatives that educate Americans about the economic benefits of trade.
  • Center for State Competitiveness: Collaborate on efforts to resist the growing trend of states seeking to tax and regulate outside their borders, disrupting interstate commerce.

Ideal candidates will possess:

  • Basic quantitative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • An interest in public policy issues, specifically budget, tax, and regulatory matters.
  • Strong research, communication, and writing skills.
Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

Overview

LMI is seeking an Information Assurance Specialist to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) in the sustainment and enhancement of the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform. This role will support cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and system authorization activities to help ensure ACWS meets applicable Army and DoD security requirements.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

The Information Assurance Specialist will work closely with system administrators, engineers, developers, DevSecOps personnel, program managers, and security stakeholders to maintain a strong security posture across a mission-critical enterprise application environment.

  • Support information assurance and cybersecurity activities for ACWS and associated enterprise environments.
  • Assist with implementation and maintenance of security controls in accordance with NIST, RMF, STIG, and applicable DoD requirements.
  • Support system security authorization, assessment, accreditation, and Authority to Operate (ATO) activities.
  • Conduct security assessments, vulnerability reviews, compliance evaluations, and security control reviews.
  • Monitor security findings and coordinate remediation activities with system, application, infrastructure, and DevSecOps teams.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation including System Security Plans (SSPs), POA&Ms, policies, procedures, assessment artifacts, and continuous monitoring documentation.
  • Assist with continuous monitoring activities, security metrics, status reporting, and cybersecurity reporting requirements.
  • Support security audits, inspections, customer assessments, and responses to identified findings.
  • Evaluate system and application changes to ensure continued compliance with established security requirements.
  • Work with stakeholders to identify cybersecurity risks and support development of practical mitigation strategies.
  • Support incident response and security investigations as needed and participate in root cause and remediation activities.
  • Stay current on evolving cybersecurity threats, regulations, security controls, and federal best practices relevant to ACWS.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 5-10+ years of experience supporting Information Assurance, cybersecurity, information security, or cyber risk management programs.
  • Knowledge of NIST cybersecurity frameworks and Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes.
  • Experience developing and maintaining security documentation and compliance artifacts.
  • Experience supporting vulnerability management, security assessments, and compliance activities.
  • Understanding of security controls, risk management, secure configuration, and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, writing, and communication skills.
  • Active Secret clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Active Secret security clearance.
  • Active DoD 8140-aligned cybersecurity certification such as CISSP, CISM, or Security+.
  • Security certifications such as Security+, CISSP, CAP, CISM, or CASP+.
  • Experience supporting Army or DoD programs and security requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity, RMF, ATO, or compliance activities for federal or DoD systems.
  • Experience with eMASS, ACAS, SCAP, STIGs, or related cybersecurity tools.
  • Practical experience with NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, or comparable federal security requirements.
  • Experience working in Agile or DevSecOps environments and integrating security tasks into delivery processes.
  • Experience supporting cloud security initiatives within AWS, Azure, or similar environments.
  • Experience with Appian-based applications or Appian Cloud security and configuration practices preferred.
  • SAFe certification such as SAFe Practitioner, Architect, or DevOps.
  • Experience supporting enterprise platform teams and shared services across multiple delivery teams.

Trabajará en colaboración con equipos de operaciones, redes y seguridad para fortalecer la postura de ciberseguridad de los clientes frente a amenazas cada vez más sofisticadas. Buscamos un perfil analítico, resolutivo y con capacidad para adaptarse a entornos tecnológicos dinámicos y en constante evolución.

  • Administrar, configurar y mantener plataformas de seguridad perimetral, con especial foco en soluciones de proxy seguro y seguridad web.
  • Gestionar la operación diaria de los servicios de seguridad asignados, asegurando el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio y la correcta atención de solicitudes e incidencias.
  • Analizar, monitorizar y gestionar eventos e incidentes de seguridad relacionados con el tráfico web, la navegación corporativa y los sistemas de acceso a Internet.
  • Realizar tareas de troubleshooting avanzado para la resolución de incidencias complejas, identificando causas raíz e implementando medidas correctivas y preventivas.
  • Evaluar, diseñar e implementar cambios en configuraciones, políticas de filtrado y controles de seguridad, garantizando el equilibrio entre protección, rendimiento y necesidades de negocio.
  • Participar en el estudio y validación de nuevas integraciones y funcionalidades de las plataformas de seguridad, contribuyendo a la evolución tecnológica de los servicios gestionados.
  • Configurar y optimizar políticas de acceso web, inspección SSL/TLS, categorización de contenidos, control de aplicaciones y protección frente a amenazas avanzadas.
  • Supervisar la actividad de las plataformas mediante herramientas de monitorización y análisis, identificando comportamientos anómalos, riesgos potenciales y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Colaborar con equipos internos y clientes en proyectos de despliegue, migración y actualización de infraestructuras de seguridad perimetral.
  • Elaborar documentación técnica relacionada con arquitecturas, configuraciones, procedimientos operativos, estándares y guías de explotación de los servicios.
  • Mantener actualizados los componentes de seguridad, revisando continuamente nuevas funcionalidades, vulnerabilidades emergentes y mejores prácticas del sector.
  • Participar en revisiones periódicas de políticas de seguridad para garantizar su alineación con los requisitos de negocio, normativos y de ciberseguridad.
  • Apoyar procesos de auditoría, cumplimiento y mejora continua relacionados con la protección perimetral y la seguridad del tráfico web.
  • Colaborar en la definición de procedimientos operativos y de respuesta ante incidentes, contribuyendo a la mejora de la eficiencia y madurez de los servicios gestionados.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia mínima de 4 años en administración avanzada, operación y soporte de plataformas Proxy y tecnologías de seguridad web.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de protocolos y tecnologías relacionadas con la navegación y seguridad en Internet, incluyendo HTTP, HTTPS, SSL/TLS y mecanismos de autenticación asociados.
  • Experiencia en administración y gestión de soluciones de firewall y controles de seguridad perimetral.
  • Capacidad analítica para la investigación, diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias complejas en entornos de producción.
  • Habilidad para trabajar de forma organizada, gestionar múltiples tareas simultáneamente y adaptarse a entornos tecnológicos cambiantes.
  • Nivel de inglés B2 o superior para la comprensión de documentación técnica, interacción con fabricantes y participación en entornos internacionales.

Se valorará positivamente

  • Certificaciones especializadas en plataformas Proxy y Secure Web Gateway, como Zscaler, Netskope, Forcepoint u otras soluciones de referencia del mercado.
  • Certificaciones técnicas de fabricantes líderes en seguridad perimetral, como Fortinet, Check Point, Palo Alto Networks o tecnologías equivalentes.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de redes LAN, WAN, routing, switching y comunicaciones corporativas.
  • Experiencia en soluciones de protección de aplicaciones web y tecnologías Imperva.
  • Formación académica o certificaciones acreditables en ciberseguridad, seguridad de redes o disciplinas relacionadas.
  • Experiencia previa en entornos SOC, servicios gestionados de seguridad (MSSP) o centros de operaciones de ciberseguridad.
  • Conocimientos de análisis de tráfico, gestión de logs, correlación de eventos y respuesta ante incidentes de seguridad.

Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto. En Inetum valoramos la expertise y el conocimiento, y queremos ayudarte a llevar tu carrera al siguiente nivel en un ambiente colaborativo y dinámico.

El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.

Únete a Inetum para participar en la transformación tecnológica y digital de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales. Estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto positivo en nuestros clientes, sus procesos y tecnología, pero también en ti.

Objetivo del puesto

Liderar la definición, gobierno y evolución del servicio EDR/XDR, siendo responsable de su propuesta de valor, catálogo de capacidades, niveles de servicio (Tiers), entregables, modelo operativo y hoja de ruta tecnológica. Apoyándose en un equipo de especialistas, asegurará la mejora continua del servicio y su alineamiento con las necesidades de los clientes, garantizando una cobertura eficaz frente a las amenazas y la incorporación de las capacidades más relevantes proporcionadas por los fabricantes estratégicos.

Perfil del candidato

Profesional con visión estratégica y orientación a la gestión de servicios, capaz de actuar como responsable de la evolución y posicionamiento de la oferta EDR/XDR y MDR, garantizando tanto la adecuación del catálogo de capacidades como su correcta implantación y adopción operativa. Deberá colaborar estrechamente con el Service Manager y los distintos equipos del SOC para asegurar la alineación entre la estrategia del servicio, las necesidades de los clientes y las capacidades tecnológicas disponibles. Combinará un conocimiento sólido de las principales plataformas EDR/XDR del mercado con capacidades de diseño de servicios, gobierno tecnológico, definición de roadmaps y mejora continua. Su éxito se medirá por la madurez, diferenciación, adopción y generación de valor del servicio, así como por su capacidad para impulsar su evolución de forma sostenible y alineada con los objetivos del negocio.

Responsabilidades principales

  • Definición y gobierno del servicio
  • Estrategia tecnológica y roadmap
  • Gestión del catálogo de capacidades
  • Definición de Tiers y modelos de servicio
  • Definición y control de entregables
  • Gobierno de detección y respuesta
  • Mejora continua del servicio
  • Soporte a áreas de negocio y preventa

Actividades a desarrollar

  • Gestionar el ciclo de vida completo del servicio EDR/XDR.
  • Definir y actualizar la estrategia de producto.
  • Revisar periódicamente el catálogo de capacidades.
  • Mantener el roadmap de evolución tecnológica.
  • Evaluar nuevas capacidades de CrowdStrike, Microsoft, Palo Alto y Trend Micro.
  • Coordinar iniciativas de mejora de cobertura de detección.
  • Realizar análisis comparativos entre plataformas y soluciones.
  • Definir estándares operativos y técnicos.
  • Participar en comités de servicio y revisiones periódicas con clientes.
  • Establecer KPIs y métricas de adopción del servicio.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automatización y optimización operativa.
  • Liderar iniciativas para mejorar la experiencia de cliente y el valor percibido del servicio.

Requisitos | Experiencia requerida

  • Más de 8 años de experiencia en ciberseguridad operacional.
  • Experiencia demostrable en la definición, evolución y gobierno de servicios de seguridad gestionada y con conocimiento profundo de plataformas EDR/XDR, especialmente:
    • CrowdStrike Falcon.
    • Microsoft Defender XDR.
    • Palo Alto Cortex XDR/XSIAM.
    • Trend Vision One.
  • Conocimiento avanzado de metodologías de detección y respuesta ante amenazas.
  • Experiencia en diseño de servicios, catálogos, modelos operativos y estrategias de evolución tecnológica.
  • Capacidad para traducir requerimientos de negocio en capacidades operativas y técnicas.
  • Experiencia en definición de KPIs, SLAs, XLAs y métricas de valor para clientes.
  • Conocimiento de arquitecturas SOC modernas y modelos MDR.

A valorar | Certificaciones

  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA).
  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR).
  • Microsoft SC-200.
  • Microsoft SC-100.
  • Palo Alto PCSAE.
  • Certificaciones Cortex XDR/XSIAM.

Conocimientos adicionales

  • Gestión de producto y diseño de servicios tecnológicos.
  • Service Design y Service Management.
  • Threat Intelligence.
  • Exposure Management.
  • Vulnerability Management.
  • Security Operations Metrics.
  • FinOps aplicado a plataformas de seguridad.
  • IA aplicada a operaciones de seguridad.
  • Automatización SOAR y Security Orchestration.

Únete a un equipo que impulsa la innovación y trabaja en proyectos de alto impacto. En Inetum valoramos la expertise y el conocimiento, y queremos ayudarte a llevar tu carrera al siguiente nivel en un ambiente colaborativo y dinámico.

Ofrecemos la oportunidad de asistir, junto al equipo de ciberseguridad, a conferencias, ponencias y charlas en Congresos de Seguridad Informática, como Navaja Negra, RootedCON, Hacken, jornadas CCN STIC, etc. al ser patrocinadores de muchos de estos eventos.

Ponemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo formativo en competencias tecnológicas y certificaciones de acuerdo con las exigencias de los proyectos y clientes. Formación en idiomas, donde podrás elegir entre 12 opciones. Formación en habilidades personales dentro del ámbito profesional. Uso de otras plataformas adicionales como Udemy y OpenWebinars.

Te ofrecemos una retribución a la carta, pudiendo elegir diferentes productos y modelar tú mismo cómo distribuirlos: seguro de salud, tickets de comida, guardería, tarjeta transporte y formación. Además, contarás con un seguro de vida incluido como parte de tus beneficios. También tendrás acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa, como descuentos en diversos productos y servicios.

El contrato será indefinido, con un horario flexible de oficina, con posibilidad de teletrabajar para poder conciliar de la mejor forma tu vida personal-profesional. Proporcionamos estabilidad y un excelente ambiente laboral, formado por los mejores profesionales en el ámbito de la Ciberseguridad.

Ofrecemos una atractiva carrera profesional en función de la experiencia y potencial personal, dentro de una compañía en continua evolución y con un sólido crecimiento.

Inetum es líder europeo en servicios digitales. El equipo de Inetum, formado por 28.000 consultores y especialistas, se esfuerza cada día por generar un impacto digital en las empresas, las entidades del sector público y la sociedad. Las soluciones de Inetum tienen como objetivo contribuir al desempeño y la innovación de sus clientes, así como al bien común.

Presente en 19 países con una densa red de sitios, Inetum se asocia con los principales editores de software para afrontar los desafíos de la transformación digital con proximidad y flexibilidad.

Impulsado por su ambición de crecimiento y escala, Inetum generó unas ventas de 2.400 millones de euros en 2024.

raw.title: Software Systems Architect - Clearance Required
raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking an experienced Software Systems Architect to support the U.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an experienced Software Systems Architect to support the U.S. Army Training Information System (ATIS) program and the ALCMC delivery team. ATIS is a major Army initiative to modernize and consolidate Army training systems into a secure, cloud-native, enterprise-level capability. As part of an Agile Release Train (ART) operating under the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), this role will lead team-level technical architecture and solution design, establish architectural runway, guide interface and integration decisions, and enable the team to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable capabilities within broader solution architecture guardrails.

This is a highly technical, collaborative, and hands-on individual contributor role. The Software Systems Architect will work directly with developers, Product Management, DevSecOps, testing, cybersecurity, and Solution Architecture to translate mission and product needs into implementable designs, reduce technical ambiguity and rework, manage architectural and technical-debt risks, and ensure architecture actively enables delivery rather than becoming an approval gate.

The ideal candidate combines strong architectural judgment with hands-on software engineering experience and is comfortable working directly with engineering teams through design, implementation, integration, troubleshooting, and technical problem solving.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Lead team-level solution design and translate mission, product, functional, and non-functional requirements into implementable technical designs.
  • Develop and maintain the team’s architectural runway, identifying technical enablers, dependencies, constraints, and architectural work needed to support upcoming capabilities.
  • Lead interface and integration design across applications, services, APIs, data sources, external systems, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Define and guide implementation of non-functional requirements (NFRs), including security, performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, observability, and testability.
  • Establish and guide team technology standards, reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering guardrails in alignment with broader Solution Architecture direction.
  • Partner with the Product Owner and Solution Architect to identify, assess, and prioritize technical debt based on mission impact, delivery risk, maintainability, and architectural health.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, system and component models, interface definitions, architectural decision records, and other technical documentation that directly supports development and delivery.
  • Work directly with developers through design sessions, whiteboarding, implementation, code and design reviews, troubleshooting, and technical mentoring to ensure architectural decisions are practical and implemented effectively.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps, testing, UX, cybersecurity, Product Management, and other stakeholders to ensure architecture supports secure CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, integration, and operational requirements.
  • Identify cross-team, environment, infrastructure, integration, and external dependencies early and drive the technical coordination necessary to reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain actively engaged in implementation and technical problem solving, including root-cause analysis of complex or recurring defects, integration issues, environment constraints, and architectural problems.
  • Promote reusable solutions, knowledge sharing, and team self-sufficiency while reducing unnecessary complexity and reliance on tribal knowledge.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering, application development, systems engineering, or technical architecture experience, including hands-on responsibility for designing and delivering production software.
  • Demonstrated experience with software/application architecture and system design, including translating functional and non-functional requirements into implementable technical solutions and making architecture tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS preferred) and understanding of cloud architecture, secure networking, identity and access management, service integration, and deployment considerations.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating applications, services, data sources, and external systems.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, automation, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with software developers through technical design, implementation guidance, code/design reviews, troubleshooting, and complex problem solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to address non-functional requirements including security, performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, observability, and testability.
  • Strong technical communication and collaborative leadership skills, with the ability to explain architecture decisions and tradeoffs to engineering, Product Management, testing, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, leadership, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile software delivery environments and leading team-level technical decisions while operating within broader solution or enterprise architecture guardrails.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modern UI/frontend technologies and frameworks such as Angular, including frontend-to-backend integration patterns.
  • Broad technical knowledge spanning applications, cloud, infrastructure/platforms, cybersecurity, integrations, data, and delivery pipelines.
  • Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable modern application/platform architectures.
  • Familiarity with architectural decision records, reference architectures, technology standards, reusable architectural patterns, and lightweight architecture governance.
  • AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer) and/or demonstrated depth in AWS architecture.
  • Experience working within a SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) and supporting architectural runway, technical enablers, PI Planning, and cross-team dependency management.
  • Experience supporting Army, DoD, federal, or other secure/regulated mission systems, including familiarity with ATO/RMF processes.
  • Experience with ATIS, Army training systems, learning management systems (LMS), or similar enterprise mission systems is a plus.
  • Additional useful experience includes UI/UX, accessibility testing, organizational change management, and demonstrated ability to rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies.

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel required, including for PI Planning, program increment events, user engagement sessions, architecture/design workshops, and key program milestones.

The target salary range for this position is $160,000 - 185,000.

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking an experienced Data Engineer – Army Vantage / Palantir Foundry to support the U.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an experienced Data Engineer – Army Vantage / Palantir Foundry to support the U.S. Army Training Information System (ATIS) program. This hands-on role will develop, maintain, and improve ATIS data products and integrations, with a primary focus on capabilities delivered through Army Vantage and Palantir Foundry.

The Data Engineer will transform authoritative ATIS data into reliable, reusable enterprise data products and ensure Vantage/Foundry capabilities integrate effectively with the broader ATIS data ecosystem. The ideal candidate has hands-on Foundry experience, strong data-engineering skills, and the ability to independently identify and resolve end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS and Vantage/Foundry.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance ATIS data products, datasets, pipelines, applications, dashboards, and related capabilities within Army Vantage/Palantir Foundry.
  • Design, build, and sustain production-quality data pipelines and transformations using Python, SQL, PySpark, and native Foundry capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain Foundry ontology objects, relationships, and data models that make authoritative ATIS data understandable, reusable, and accessible to approved users.
  • Integrate authoritative ATIS data with Vantage/Foundry and other Army enterprise data sources while maintaining data quality, lineage, and appropriate access controls.
  • Trace, diagnose, and drive resolution of end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS source data, interfaces, transformations, pipelines, and Vantage/Foundry products.
  • Develop Foundry-native dashboards, applications, reports, and other data products to support Army analytics, visualization, reporting, and mission needs.
  • Implement data-quality validation, monitoring, scheduling, error handling, and other practices necessary to operate reliable production data products.
  • Apply sound software and data-engineering practices, including version control, peer review, testing, documentation, and CI/CD where supported.
  • Work directly with product owners, engineers, architects, analysts, and users to translate mission needs into practical technical solutions and support appropriate use of authoritative ATIS data.
  • Document solutions, share knowledge, and build team capability so ATIS can sustain and extend its data and Foundry capabilities without creating single-person dependencies.
  • Operate as a self-directed member of the Agile team, taking ownership of technical outcomes and independently driving problems toward resolution.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, or development of production data products.
  • Hands-on experience developing or maintaining solutions in Palantir Foundry and/or Army Vantage, with sufficient familiarity to contribute with limited platform-specific ramp-up.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, analysis, automation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines involving complex or disparate datasets.
  • Experience with data modeling, including schemas, keys, relationships, reference data, and transformation of source data into reusable data products.
  • Experience with Foundry ontology, semantic data models, or comparable enterprise data structures.
  • Experience with PySpark, Spark, Pandas, or comparable technologies for transforming complex datasets.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data pipelines, integrations, data-quality issues, and production data products, including tracing problems across source systems and downstream consumers.
  • Ability to work independently from mission intent or a desired end state while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary technical and product teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Active DoD Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience developing and sustaining data products within Army Vantage.
  • Experience integrating DoD/Army authoritative data sources and working with enterprise data-quality, lineage, governance, and access-control requirements.
  • Experience developing Foundry-native applications, dashboards, reports, or custom interfaces.
  • Experience applying software-engineering practices such as Git/version control, peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD to data products.
  • Familiarity with APIs, cloud data services, and enterprise system integration.
  • Experience working within an Agile or SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) environment.
  • Applicable DoD 8140 cybersecurity/workforce qualification, where required.
  • Experience supporting Army, DoD, federal, or other secure/regulated mission systems.

Target salary range: $120,000 - $155,000

raw.excerpt: About the position We're looking for a QA Analyst to join our Quality team and help ensure the quality of Fanatee's mobile game portfolio.
raw.description:
About the position
We're looking for a QA Analyst to join our Quality team and help ensure the quality of Fanatee's mobile game portfolio. You'll work closely with developers, product, and design to catch issues before they reach our players, and help build a more efficient testing process as our games evolve.

What you’ll do
  • Execute manual and exploratory testing across our game portfolio, covering functional, regression and edge-case scenarios.
  • Identify, document and report bugs clearly, with reproduction steps, severity and impact, so the dev team can act fast.
  • Build and maintain test plans and checklists for critical game flows.
  • Support test automation efforts, contributing to scripts and coverage under guidance from senior QA.
  • Use AI-assisted QA tools (test case generation, log summarization, bug triage support) to speed up repetitive work, always validating results critically.
  • Track testing tasks and bugs in our project management tools (Jira/Azure DevOps), keeping status updated.
  • Collaborate directly with developers to clarify, prioritize and follow up on reported issues.
  • Test across different devices, OS versions and stores (iOS/Android) to catch platform-specific issues.

What you’ll need
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent practical experience) .
  • Understanding of software testing fundamentals (test cases, regression, exploratory testing).
  • Strong attention to detail, able to spot small, non-obvious inconsistencies in gameplay, UI or text.
  • Good organizational skills to manage multiple test cycles at once.
  • Programming knowledge (C#) with hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests. Not senior-level, but able to build test scripts independently, not just follow a script someone else wrote.

Nice to have
  • Experience with Unity or mobile game development.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered testing tools (test case generation, automated regression, visual QA).
  • Experience with test automation frameworks
  • Previous QA experience in mobile games or apps.
  • Comfortable reading English (docs, tools, error logs).
  • Proactive. Flags risks and suggests process improvements without being asked.
  • Comfortable with repetitive tasks without losing rigor or focus.
  • Collaborative, with strong communication skills to work closely with developers under tight release cycles.
  • Curious and adaptable, comfortable with fast-changing priorities typical of game development.
  • Genuine interest in mobile games.
What We Offer
  • Beyond a vibrant and enjoyable work atmosphere, we offer:
  • Competitive compensation aligned with market standards
  • Flexible benefits
  • Health and dental insurance
  • Profit sharing
  • Career development opportunities and professional growth
While the role is primarily remote, our São Paulo office is available for those seeking a dedicated workspace. There, you’ll find a calm environment, a stocked fridge with snacks and drinks, and even a ping-pong table for a bit of fun. Come help shape the future whith our amazing team!

About Fanatee
Fanatee is a mobile gaming startup founded in 2013. Since then, our goal has been to enable people to play our games anytime, anywhere. We believe that quality is the key to success.Our creative processes are well planned and carefully detailed, and our talent lies in turning great ideas into great businesses: our games hit over 250M downloads worldwide. We believe that a diverse work environment contributes to an increasingly responsible society that values differences. Our dream allows us to do what we love the most: work with talented, passionate people and give them the opportunity to achieve goals as big as they can dream of.

If you want to share this ride with us and join a lightweight, fun and focused environment that breathes innovation and game culture, apply now!

raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit has a flexible workforce! If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like. Don't live near one of our offices? No worries: You can apply to work remotely in any country in which we have a physical presence.

Role Description:

This is a Generalist Senior Backend Engineer position within the Ads Organization. Ads is the fuel that powers Reddit’s mission. As a backend engineer on the team, candidates might work on:

  • Microservices and APIs that power our advertiser-facing product, ads.reddit.com
  • Distributed systems that ensure the right ad gets shown to the right user at the right time
  • Backends that power interactive user experiences on our ads like Polls and Games
  • Real time, data intensive systems that measure the performance of our ad campaigns
  • Infrastructure that supports all of the above

Technologies used on the team include:

  • Languages: Go, Python, Scala
  • Frameworks: Spark, Thrift, Baseplate, Kafka
  • Datastores: Postgres, BigQuery, Redis, Druid
  • Tools: Kubernetes, Argo, Docker

Responsibilities:

  • Work with product managers to design and implement Ads products.
  • Collaborate closely with the platform and data teams while building new features.
  • Lead the processes needed to improve operational stability, including improving code quality, delivering dashboards and data visualizations.
  • Build extensible components that would align with the product objectives.
  • Support day to day project management tasks including communicating project updates, managing project timelines and overseeing project execution.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software development experience in one or more general purpose programming languages (Java, Scala, Go, C++, Python).
  • Able to take complete ownership of a feature or project.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working in the Ads domain
  • Experience or interest in the advertising business and understanding customer needs

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is continuing to grow our teams with the best talent. This role is completely remote friendly within the United States. If you happen to live close to one of our physical office locations (San Francisco, Los Angeles, New York City & Chicago) our doors are open for you to come into the office as often as you'd like.

As Reddit’s advertising ecosystem rapidly expands, protecting our platform, advertisers, and users from bad actors is paramount. We are seeking a Staff Threat Analyst to serve as the operational architect for Advertiser Fraud within Safety. You will have end-to-end ownership to establish the strategy, build foundational detection playbooks, and define enforcement frameworks.

You will work in tight partnership with cross-functional Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Ops teams across both Safety and Ads orgs to convert adversarial insights into scalable automated defenses. This is a 0-to-1 opportunity to shape our threat response frameworks, operational playbooks, and detection pipelines from scratch.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & System Architecture: Formulate and execute a multi-quarter vision for advertiser fraud detection and enforcement; independently prioritize high-impact risks like account takeover (ATO), payment/billing fraud, cloaking, deceptive ads and network abuse.
  • Deep Analytics & Investigations: Conduct deep-dive investigations into complex, multi-entity fraud networks and sophisticated adversarial tactics. Drive root-cause analysis and map cluster infrastructure to prevent recurring abuse.
  • Product/XFN Delivery: Partner directly with Data Science and Engineering to translate investigative findings into high-precision detection logic, risk scores, and automated enforcement pipelines. Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

  • The direct measurability of digital media.
  • Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
  • The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

Job Category

Join us to shape how users discover and interact with our marketplace. You’ll advance algorithms for ordering, prioritization, and personalization. Ranking is a core component which helps users discover ads, balance user satisfaction, business goals, and system health.

Responsibilities

  • Design and improve ranking systems through rigorous measurement and experimentation; translate broad goals into clear metrics and deliver steady, validated gains.

raw.description:
At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.
As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency.
At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you.

Why Offchain?

Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.
Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.
Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.
To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.

Who You Are

  • Eager to dive into blockchain technology, even if it’s new territory
  • Enjoy solving infrastructure problems in unconventional ways and thinking beyond standard patterns
  • Use tools like k9s or ArgoCD for speed and abstraction, but comfortable dropping into YAML, logs, or low-level debugging when things go sideways
  • Experienced with GitOps-style systems and treating both infrastructure and application delivery as code
  • Have scaled deployment automation using patterns like ArgoCD ApplicationSets or similar tooling
  • Curious about how things work under the hood and not satisfied with surface-level fixes
  • Comfortable in Linux, fluent in shell scripting, and productive in languages like Python or Go
  • Comfortable operating within a cloud platform (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), with a strong understanding of the underlying components making it easy to adapt to or migrate across providers
  • Participated in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents, troubleshooting under pressure, and driving postmortems to improve system reliability over time
  • Design systems with security in mind, applying principles like least privilege and threat modeling
  • Bring a strong technical foundation, excellent problem-solving skills, and a genuine commitment to high-quality work
  • Take ownership, collaborate openly, and contribute to a culture of clarity, curiosity, and continuous improvement

What You've Done

  • Operated production Kubernetes clusters and built scalable, declarative infrastructure using Terraform or similar tools
  • Deployed and maintained Kubernetes environments, managed system components, and troubleshot applications running on the platform
  • Designed CI/CD workflows with ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, CodeBuild, or similar tools, covering both infra and app deployments
  • Designed and operated observability systems using time-series metrics, logs, and dashboards with tools like Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Grafana, and CloudWatch
  • Diagnosed tough networking and storage issues across complex, distributed systems
  • Implemented secure-by-default infrastructure and contributed to architecture reviews and threat models
  • Automated operational workflows using scripting or programming in Python, Go, or Bash
  • SREs come from a wide range of backgrounds. If you bring strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a drive to build reliable systems, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly match every bullet point

Perks:

  • Remote-first global workforce + NY office
  • Professional reimbursement program (facilitates industry conference attendance, certifications, and more)
  • Medical, dental & vision coverage (US + some other countries)
  • 401k retirement plan + company match (US only)
  • Wellness stipend
  • Home office set up / ergonomic equipment program

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Network Security Engineer to join our Network team. This role combines deep expertise in network engineering and cybersecurity. You will help implement end-to-end network security architectures for enterprise and data center backbone/fabric environments, work with network architects and the management team to guide these designs through review and approval with the Security team, and operate and maintain the implemented solutions day-to-day.
You are expected to be hands-on with leading firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Check Point, etc.), understand complex routing and switching designs, and be comfortable implementing and troubleshooting these networks.

Responsibilities
  • Implement and maintain Zero Trust-aligned security architectures for both enterprise and data center networks.
  • Configure Layer 3/4 & Multi-VRF Segmentation, Security Policies, Secure Remote access.
  • Implement and test large hyper scale DC Security solutions : IPS/NDR solutions , AntiDDOS solutions.
  • Integrate NGFW platforms with modern identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, maintain NGFW management, automation, and logging capabilities required by the Security team.
  • Implement and maintain Security Capabilities, including Layer 7 application inspection, IPS, user identification, ZTNA, and SASE integrations.
  • Integrate and operate monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, and Akvorado.
  • Regularly perform security hardening, vulnerability management, and patching and upgrades on network and infrastructure devices, and verify the effectiveness of these procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in networking and security protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP(S), DNS, TLS, IPsec, Routing protocols)
  • Experience and Knowledge of Backbone & Datacenter technologies (EVPN, L3VPN MPLS, MPBGP, L2VPN..)
  • Hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, or similar).
  • Experience with automation using Python, Go, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in Unix/Linux and experience with major network vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, etc.).
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting NGFW capabilities and integrations, including IPS, User-ID, Microsoft Entra ID, and ZTNA.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Good knowledge of IPv6.
  • Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, NetBox, SaltStack, etc.).
  • Experience with large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and micro-segmentation approaches.
  • Relevant certifications (CCNP/CCIE, PCNSE, NSE 4/7) and professional working proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with commercial or open-source monitoring, logging, and security analytics solutions such as Splunk; EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike; and centralized NGFW management platforms such as Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, and FortiManager.
  • Bonus: Exposure to DevSecOps practices (SAST/DAST), CSPM/CWPP platforms such as Wiz, EDR, offensive security (OSCP/CPTS, red teaming), or security frameworks, standards, and regulations such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and GDPR.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

raw.description:
Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:


As Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sustainable commercial growth across the region while protecting the premium positioning and long-term equity of ARC’TERYX. You will shape and execute the regional wholesale strategy, developing strategic partnerships with leading outdoor specialty, mountain, trail running and premium sporting goods retailers. You will have the opportunity to build and strengthen a high-performing regional sales organization while creating new structures, processes and commercial opportunities across diverse EMEA markets. Working across countries, channels and cultures, you will navigate the complexity of balancing ambitious growth objectives with disciplined distribution and exceptional brand presentation. This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in growing the ARC’TERYX footwear business and strengthening our credibility within the outdoor community through authentic retail partnerships, technical expertise and meaningful consumer experiences.
This role can be hired remote. Business operations occur on Central European Time (CET/CEST) and extensive travel throughout EMEA is required.

Meet Your Future Team:


The EMEA Wholesale team is responsible for building strong, long-term partnerships with our retail and distribution network while delivering sustainable commercial growth across the region. Working collaboratively across markets, functions and channels, the team is focused on strengthening our premium distribution, elevating the consumer experience and ensuring ARC’TERYX products are represented with authenticity and excellence.

If you were in the Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:

  • Developing and executing the EMEA wholesale footwear strategy in alignment with global business objectives and regional market opportunities
  • Building and strengthening long-term partnerships with leading outdoor specialty retailers, mountain shops, trail running specialists, premium sporting goods retailers and selected omnichannel partners
  • Leading and developing regional sales representatives, Key Account Managers, Area Sales Managers, Technical Representatives and agencies to deliver a high-performance, partnership-led sales culture
  • Managing commercial planning across markets and strategic accounts, including annual agreements, Joint Business Plans, seasonal pre-orders, in-season replenishment and sell-through performance
  • Collaborating cross-functionally and across international markets to optimize assortments, forecasting, inventory productivity, merchandising standards and future collection strategies

Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:

  • Delivering sustainable double-digit growth across priority EMEA markets while protecting premium distribution and long-term brand equity
  • Strengthening strategic relationships with leading specialty outdoor retailers and key distribution partners across the region
  • Increasing footwear sell-through through stronger assortment planning, retail activation, technical education and premium merchandising
  • Improving forecasting accuracy, inventory productivity and commercial visibility across EMEA
  • Developing multi-year business plans by region, country and strategic account to identify and unlock sustainable growth opportunities
  • Elevating ARC’TERYX footwear visibility and credibility within the outdoor community through strategic retail initiatives, athlete engagement, product testing, field clinics and authentic consumer experiences
  • Building a high-performance regional sales culture focused on consultative selling, collaboration, coaching and long-term partnership
  • Strengthening distribution and channel discipline to ensure every commercial decision contributes to the long-term value of the brand

Are you our next Wholesale Footwear Manager EMEA?

  • You have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sports Management or a related field
  • You bring 8–10+ years of international sales experience, ideally within premium outdoor, technical footwear or a related premium sporting goods environment
  • You have a proven track record managing wholesale business across multiple EMEA markets
  • You have a strong network within the European outdoor footwear and specialty retail community
  • You have experience negotiating complex international commercial agreements and developing long-term strategic customer partnerships
  • You have demonstrated success in delivering profitable growth while protecting premium brand positioning and disciplined distribution
  • You have strong commercial, analytical and strategic planning capabilities, with the ability to translate market opportunities into actionable business plans
  • You are an experienced people leader and coach, capable of inspiring sales teams, agencies and cross-functional partners toward ambitious objectives
  • You are comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures and markets, balancing regional consistency with local market needs
  • You have experience using Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms and/or retail analytics tools
  • You are fluent in English, with German highly desirable; French, Italian or Spanish would be advantageous
  • You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions
  • You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity and a fast-evolving business environment
  • You effectively balance autonomy and collaboration while working across international markets
  • You inspire breakthrough thinking, continuous improvement and a high-performance sales culture
  • You seek the best solutions, with an unwavering commitment to leaving it better
  • Your passion for commercial excellence is matched by your passion for getting outside and maintaining genuine credibility within the outdoor community

    • This role requires approximately 50-70% international travel throughout EMEA, with a focus on Europe, as well as approximately four annual journeys to Vancouver for key company moments such as Kick Off and Leadership Summit. You will regularly engage with specialty retailers, distributors, outdoor events, athlete activations, mountain festivals and international trade shows, while participating in product testing, field clinics and outdoor experiences to maintain deep product and consumer credibility.

Equal Opportunity

Arc’teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and acceptance.
Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities where we operate.
All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in alignment with our values.

Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there’s always a better way.
Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.
Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.
Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.
