raw.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend- and distributed-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end-to-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow.

You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries.

Job Responsibilities

    DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers
  • Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

    • ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

  • Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.
  • Partner with CloudOps, Security, MLOps, and integration teams to define reliability targets, operational-readiness standards, and clean interfaces between domains.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar for data-model and systems design, security, and design-document quality.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving industry, particularly the rapid evolution of AI capabilities, and drive pragmatic adoption where it delivers clear business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's and/or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software or Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years at staff level.
  • Demonstrated leadership of architecture decisions spanning multiple teams with concrete examples of driving cross-team technical direction to a decision.
  • Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across diverse stakeholders and teams that report into different functions, aligning divergent interests without direct authority.
  • Track record of owning significant initiatives end to end, including release ownership.
  • Strong proficiency in Python (working experience in Java a plus), building backend and cloud-based services.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating scalable, enterprise-grade distributed systems on AWS.
  • Strong data-modeling and service-architecture skills, with a track record of building durable, reusable abstractions that other teams adopt and extend without rework.
  • Experience designing backend systems that enable demanding workloads wih high-throughput data pipelines, asynchronous processing, or ML/inference services at scale and with cost-efficiently.
  • Solid grounding in application security and multi-tenancy: authentication/authorization, token handling, tenant isolation, and permission-aware data access.
  • Experience designing high-scale API contracts
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD for cloud services.
  • Strong understanding of observability in distributed systems: logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • A demonstrated habit of staying current with rapidly evolving AI capabilities and integrating them into how you work and design.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English

Preferred Qualifications

    Additional Experience (a plus)

  • Building services that support AI/ML product features and data pipelines
  • Integrating third-party SaaS platforms and connectors with attention to security and reliability.
  • Search and retrieval systems
  • Domain familiarity with CLM, contracts, or comparable enterprise B2B platforms.

Background checks will be conducted on an ongoing basis every 3 years or as needed for individuals in this role.

raw.description:
Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: the Live HCP Engagement Platform that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn live events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

Pharma companies use event platforms as registration forms while request, approval, budget, HCP registration, transfer of value (ToV), and reporting run in Excel and at agencies. We are building Onomi 360, the life-sciences strategic meetings management (SMM) product, to replace the incumbent event platform in that space. First accounts already run their meeting requests and approvals in Onomi 360; the demand is validated and the trajectory is exciting.

Your focus will be MeetingsEQ, the SMM layer of Onomi 360: one front door for every request, approval and budget as configuration, unified HCP identity, per-attendee ToV allocation, and engagement and spend flowing back into the CRM without re-keying. The customer's CRM and master data stay where they are; the event platform behind the meetings program is where we play. AI-assisted development is how we work, and you will have real freedom to use it.

This position is the ideal role for a hands-on product leader from the life-sciences meetings, compliance, or HCP-data world who would rather ship and test than talk about the problem, and who wants to own one product end to end and see the process they once operated replaced with a modern, AI-first workflow.

As a Senior Product Manager, Onomi 360, you will be reporting to the VP Product. Your time will be spent on:

  • [35%] Defining the detailed product. Turn customer workbooks, operating procedures, RFP requirements, and our capability map into roadmap priorities and build-ready specifications.
  • [30%] Shipping. Work daily with design and engineering in the Onomi 360 codebase: thin production slices, prototypes, scope calls, validation in the running product. Daily AI-based prototyping and customer validation.
  • [25%] Customers and partners. Work with meetings operations, compliance, medical affairs, finance, agencies, and the customer’s data team. Define how Onomi 360 works with Veeva, Salesforce, Snowflake, and consent, and own the venue-sourcing and fair-market-value partner integrations.
  • [10%] Product truth. Keep what we claim, what we demo, and what we ship documented, clear and moving in the right direction.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first month, you will:

  • Take over the first customer’s move from their meeting request form to Onomi 360: spec, build, history migration, customer session.
  • Get set up with AI-based toolkit and the Onomi 360 codebase, and use both in your daily work.
  • Meet the early access customers (design partners) for Onomi 360.

After 3 months, you will have:

  • The first customer live on meeting request and approvals in Onomi 360, measured against their baseline.
  • The roadmap priorities for the next two quarters defined, and the first priorities specified to build depth with engineering.
  • A clean separation everyone uses: aspirational (slides), forward-looking (prototype-based demo), and committed (roadmap and backlog).

After 6 months, you will have:

  • The full end-to-end MeetingsEQ product specified and engineering-reviewed, request through approval, budget, HCP registration, ToV, and reporting.
  • One customer replacing Excel with the Onomi 360 ToV module, and the first live account expanded from request and approval into budget, ToV, or venue sourcing.

After 12 months, you will have:

  • One customer closing a full ToV reporting cycle in Onomi 360 instead of Excel.
  • Three accounts running request to closure in production, and the org-wide calendar or HCP engagement view used outside compliance.
  • Onomi 360 winning the meetings-management scope in RFPs.

What you need to be great at

  • Life-sciences meetings, compliance, or transparency operations. You have built or operated workflows spanning approval, budgeting, ToV, and closure, and you know what EFPIA and Sunshine disclosure mean in practice.
  • HCP data and integration fluency. Identity across Veeva, Salesforce, OneKey, and NPI; match rates; what a data team expects from a write-back.
  • Domain-to-product translation. A messy operating process becomes states, rules, configuration, permissions, and audit events, with regulation separated from customer policy.
  • Sequencing. The smallest production slice that proves the model without hiding the hard architectural or compliance question.
  • Bias to execute. You ship, prototype, and put things in front of users in days, not spend weeks describing the problem. You drive decisions to a close and pull others along.
  • Precise writing and direct communication. Specs detailed enough to build and review, plain words, disagreement in the open.
  • Technical and AI fluency. You work in Claude Code or OpenAI Codex, you understand code, data flows, and architecture well enough to challenge an engineering design. You know the software development lifecycle deeply, from RFC and specification through review, release, and support. AI takes you from evidence to a testable artifact in hours.

What we want to hear about

  1. Life-sciences meetings and transfer of value. Tell us about a meetings or transfer-of-value process you built or ran end to end, from request through approval, budget, HCP registration, and disclosure. Where did it break, and what did you change? This is the process Onomi 360 replaces, and we want someone who has lived it.
  2. From operating process to product. Tell us about a messy process you turned into a product: which rules you made fixed, which you made configurable, what you integrated, and what you left manual. That translation is the heart of this role.
  3. Shipping fast. Tell us about the last thing you shipped or prototyped within two weeks of first hearing the problem. What did you skip, and what did users do with it? Here you put working software in front of pharma design partners every few weeks, not slides.
  4. Building with AI. Tell us about something you built yourself with Claude Code or another AI tool that changed a product decision, and what it taught you about the code or the architecture underneath. AI-assisted development is how we build, and you will have real freedom to use it.

Fluent English (written and spoken). Remote, based in Europe or in the US Eastern or Central time zones, with about 10-20 % travel to design partners and industry events.

SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We're looking for a Partner Field Sales Manager based in the US. This is a high-energy, relationship-driven professional who can accelerate revenue by driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced sales across the Nebius partner ecosystem in North America.

This is a quota-carrying role responsible for working hand-in-hand with our field sales teams and strategic partners (Nvidia), including Global system integrators (SI's & GSI's), and channel partners across the North American market to identify, influence, and close new opportunities. You'll also play a key role in expanding and deepening our partnerships throughout these markets, helping source & qualify new opportunities, developing joint solutions, and driving GTM with partners.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong sales instincts, partnership acumen, and executive presence. We are looking for someone who can think strategically while executing rigorously to deliver incremental revenue and pipeline growth across North America.

What You'll Do

  • Own and deliver against a revenue quota for partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings across the assigned North American Sales segment.
  • Collaborate closely with the field sales teams to integrate partners into key account strategies and deal cycles.
  • Build and execute strong joint sales motions with SIs, GSI's, Nvidia, and channel partners to expand the Nebius reach and accelerate pipeline across these markets.
  • Serve as the primary partner sales interface for your assigned Nebius sales segment, ensuring alignment between regional sellers, partners' field teams, and global partner programs.
  • Develop and execute joint account planning workshops, account collaboration calls, partner campaigns, and demand-generation activities with priority partners across these markets.
  • Drive joint forecasting, pipeline visibility, and reporting to ensure partner contributions are tracked and recognized.
  • Define joint GTM plays, delivery frameworks, and enablement paths to ensure scalable, repeatable customer success.
  • Work closely with the global and regional Partner Development, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment of partner strategy, programs, and field execution across these markets.

  • Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Continuously refine partner engagement models based on data-driven insights and field feedback in a dynamic market.

Who You Are

  • Partner-Savvy: Deep understanding of SI/GSI, Channel, and Nvidia partner models including co-sell, marketplace, and resale motions.
  • Strategic + Tactical Operator: Can develop GTM strategy and roll up sleeves to drive execution with field and partner teams.
  • Strong Communicator & Influencer: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; comfortable engaging both internally and externally at executive levels.
  • Relationship Builder: Skilled at navigating complex partner organizations, aligning incentives, and building long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Self-Starter with Grit: Operates autonomously, thrives in high-growth build environments, and drives outcomes without heavy structure.
  • Collaborative Team Player: Works seamlessly across sales, marketing, product, and partner functions; coachable and open to feedback.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

  • Career growth and learning opportunities

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We're looking for a Senior MarTech Manager to set the technology and operational strategy behind our marketing programs. This person will define how marketing strategy, data, systems, and execution connect, ensuring our tools work together, data is trustworthy, and teams can scale their use of technology to acquire, engage, and retain customers.

The ideal candidate operates at both altitudes: setting a multi-year MarTech strategy and architecture direction, while staying close enough to the stack to make sound build-vs-buy and integration calls. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over cross-functional priorities, vendor spend, and technical direction, partnering closely with Marketing, Data, Product, and Engineering leadership.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Set strategy and own architecture decisions for the MarTech stack, including build-vs-buy calls and vendor relationships.
  • Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for marketing technology, automation, analytics, and personalization.
  • Direct the platform strategy for CRM, marketing automation, CDP, analytics, attribution, experimentation, and customer engagement tools.
  • Architect data flows between marketing systems, product systems, CRM, and the data warehouse, and set the standards other teams build against.
  • Establish and enforce governance standards for tracking, campaign setup, lifecycle management, and data quality across the org.
  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Data, Product and Engineering leadership (Director/VP level) to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.
  • Identify and lead automation initiatives that materially reduce manual campaign operations.
  • Own the technical foundation for segmentation, lifecycle marketing, personalization, and reporting.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, selection, and contract negotiation; own implementation and adoption outcomes.
  • Build documentation, governance frameworks, and processes that make the MarTech ecosystem scalable and auditable.
  • Monitor system performance, data quality, and operational risk, and escalate/resolve complex issues before they become team-wide blockers.

raw.title: Data Scientist
raw.excerpt: We're looking for a Data Scientist to lead the design and development of optimization and machine learning models that allocate scarce parts and resources across competing programs.
raw.description:
We're looking for a Data Scientist to lead the design and development of optimization and machine learning models that allocate scarce parts and resources across competing programs. You'll build algorithms spanning mixed-integer programming, constraint optimization, and ML-driven forecasting that turn hard supply constraints into defensible, auditable allocation decisions. You'll own the full modeling lifecycle, from problem formulation and data exploration through validation and production deployment, partnering closely with program stakeholders to translate competing priorities into solvable objectives. This is a high-visibility role for someone who moves fluidly between rigorous quantitative modeling and pragmatic, program-facing communication.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement optimization models (e.g., mixed-integer linear programming, constraint programming) for allocating scarce parts and resources across competing programs.
  • Develop ML models to forecast demand, supply risk, and part availability, feeding those forecasts directly into allocation logic.
  • Translate ambiguous, competing program priorities into formal objective functions and constraints.
  • Validate model outputs against historical allocation decisions and stakeholder expectations; iterate on formulations as new constraints emerge.
  • Build and maintain the data pipelines needed to keep optimization models current with live inventory, demand, and program data.
  • Present modeling tradeoffs and recommendations to non-technical program and supply-chain stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior data scientists on optimization techniques and modeling best practices.
  • Partner with software engineers to productionize models as scalable services.
  • Master's or PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 6+ years of experience building optimization and/or ML models for resource allocation, scheduling, or supply chain problems.
  • Deep hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) and formulating MILP/constraint optimization problems.
  • Strong Python skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch) and data manipulation libraries (pandas, NumPy).
  • Experience working with messy, real-world supply chain, inventory, or program data.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting complex tradeoffs to program and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with allocation problems in aerospace, defense, or manufacturing supply chains.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) and how allocation decisions flow into procurement and production planning.
  • Experience deploying optimization models as production services (APIs, batch pipelines).
  • Exposure to reinforcement learning or Bayesian methods for decision-making under uncertainty.

We Value:

  • Drive: Passion and energy to implement quality technical solutions. Self-motivation and intellectual curiosity
  • Commitment to Quality: Passion to conceive and produce world-class solutions that drive real-world value for the customer
  • Customer Focus: Consultative approach to solving problems for customers. Expectations management.
  • Communication: Superior communication skills. Ability to clearly articulate problems, solutions, risks, rewards etc. (written and verbal)
  • Technical Skills: Love for technology. You have to be inherently passionate about technology.
  • Business Acumen: Technology ultimately is used to enable the business. We look for people who understand how the businesses can be enabled through their technical solutions

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

Protective Life is transforming how it builds and operates software — moving to a product operating model organized around empowered, outcome-oriented teams — and is putting machine learning and generative AI to work in the products that serve our customers. Voyager is one of these product pods, spanning our Life, Annuities, and Employee Benefits lines.

As a JR or SR AI Developer on Voyager, you help build the AI-powered features and services that reach real users — integrating large language models and ML into Voyager's products on our Databricks Lakehouse and Microsoft Azure. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role focused on application engineering with AI. You will build well-scoped features with guidance from senior engineers and the AI/ML Engineering Lead, working closely with product managers, designers, and data engineers. As a regulated life insurer, we expect AI features to be accurate, well-documented, and appropriate in their handling of sensitive customer data.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    JUNIOR:

    • Build AI-powered application features and services on Azure Databricks and Azure — integrating LLMs and ML models into Voyager's products, with guidance on design from senior engineers.
    • Implement GenAI capabilities — retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, prompt and system design, and tool/function calling.
    • Develop and consume APIs and services that expose model capabilities to product surfaces, with attention to latency, reliability, and cost.
    • Apply evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review to keep AI outputs accurate, safe, and appropriate for a regulated insurer.
    • Work with the pod's data stack — dlt (dltHub), dbt, and Dagster — to source and prepare grounding data and features for AI capabilities.
    • Deploy and version the models and prompts your features use with MLflow and Databricks Model Serving, following patterns set by the AI/ML Engineering Lead.
    • Write clean, tested, version-controlled code and ship it through Azure DevOps (ADO) CI/CD.
    • Instrument AI features for monitoring — output quality, latency, cost, and user feedback — and help iterate based on evidence.
    • Apply secure-by-default and privacy practices for sensitive customer and policyholder data used in AI features — PII handling, access control, and data minimization in prompts and context.
    • Collaborate with product managers and designers to refine AI features through discovery and iteration.
    • Contribute to responsible-AI and governance practices — evaluation evidence, documentation, and adherence to model/AI governance expectations.
    • Grow your craft — seek and apply feedback in code and design reviews, and share what you learn with the pod.

      • SENIOR:

      • Design and build AI-powered application features and services on Azure Databricks and Azure — integrating LLMs and ML models into Voyager's products.
      • Develop GenAI capabilities — retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, prompt and system design, tool/function calling, and agentic workflows.
      • Build and consume APIs and services that expose model capabilities to product surfaces, with attention to latency, reliability, and cost.
      • Implement evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review to keep AI outputs accurate, safe, and appropriate for a regulated insurer.
      • Integrate with the pod's data stack — dlt (dltHub), dbt, and Dagster — to source and prepare grounding data and features for AI capabilities.
      • Deploy and version the models and prompts your features depend on using MLflow and Databricks Model Serving, in partnership with the AI/ML Engineering Lead.
      • Write clean, tested, version-controlled code and ship it through Azure DevOps (ADO) CI/CD.
      • Instrument AI features for monitoring — output quality, latency, drift, cost, and user feedback — and iterate based on evidence.
      • Apply secure-by-default and privacy practices for sensitive customer and policyholder data used in AI features — PII handling, access control, and data minimization in prompts and context.
      • Partner with product managers and designers to shape AI features through discovery and rapid, evidence-based iteration.
      • Contribute to responsible-AI and governance practices — documentation, evaluation evidence, and adherence to model/AI governance expectations.
      • Mentor less-experienced engineers and share applied-AI patterns and reusable components across the pod.

QUALIFICATIONS

    JUNIOR:

    REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • 3–5 years of software development experience, including hands-on work building AI-powered or GenAI applications.
    • Solid programming skills — Python required; familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript or a JVM language a plus — with sound software-engineering fundamentals (APIs, services, testing).
    • Practical experience building GenAI/LLM features — RAG, embeddings and vector search, prompt/system design, and basic evaluation.
    • Experience integrating models via APIs and model-serving platforms — exposure to Azure OpenAI and Databricks Model Serving / MLflow preferred.
    • Familiarity with the modern data stack the pod uses — dlt (dltHub), dbt, and Dagster — on a Databricks lakehouse (Delta Lake); willingness to grow here.
    • Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps / ADO preferred) and Git-based, test-supported development practices.
    • Working knowledge of a cloud environment (Microsoft Azure preferred), including AI/OpenAI services basics.
    • SQL and comfort working with data.
    • Attention to evaluation, documentation, and secure, compliant handling of sensitive data.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

      • PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

      • Experience in financial services or insurance products (Life, Annuities, claims, servicing, or customer experience).
      • Experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel) and vector stores (Databricks Vector Search or Azure AI Search).
      • Front-end or full-stack experience delivering AI features into user-facing products.
      • Familiarity with responsible-AI and evaluation tooling, and with bias/fairness and explainability considerations.
      • Relevant certification such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate or a Databricks GenAI/ML credential.

        • SENIOR

        REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

        • 5–8 years of software development experience, including recent, hands-on work building AI-powered or GenAI applications.
        • Strong programming skills — Python required; familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript or a JVM language a plus — with solid software-engineering fundamentals (APIs, services, testing).
        • Hands-on experience building GenAI/LLM applications — RAG, embeddings and vector databases, prompt/system design, tool/function calling, and structured evaluation.
        • Experience integrating models via APIs and model-serving platforms — Azure OpenAI and Databricks Model Serving / MLflow preferred.
        • Experience working with the modern data stack the pod uses — dlt (dltHub), dbt, and Dagster — on a Databricks lakehouse (Delta Lake).

In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.
Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, andthe results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.
This role calls for a strong hunter mindset and passion for working in a hyper-growth MarTech scale-up with a rapid sales cycle. Good news: our differentiated product is already in high demand! You will identify emerging markets and market shifts while being fully aware of new products and competition status.

  • You will present sales, revenue, and realistic forecasts to the management team.
  • You will get supported by Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, and Sales Enablement functions.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields.
  • Minimum 4 years of quota-carrying sales experience, preferably in SaaS or MarTech.
  • Knowledge of market research, sales, and negotiating principles.
  • Proven verbal and written communication abilities, effective phone skills, and exquisite listening skills.
  • Our technical knowledge goes well beyond that of any other salesperson. You need to be a savvy tech bug, always searching for solutions and ideas.
  • Ability to succeed working cross-functionally with direct sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
  • Superior project and time management skills.

What We Offer

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.
To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

raw.excerpt: Digital Designer PH location / Remote first Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world?
raw.description:
Digital Designer

PH location / Remote first

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role We are looking for a creative and collaborative Digital Designer to join our Digital Product team! In this role, your goal is simple: help us design the digital experiences that turn curious consumers into loyal subscribers.

Working closely with our eCommerce Specialist, Growth Marketing, and Creative partners, you will take our brand campaigns and translate them into engaging on-site experiences. You’ll work closely with our Product Designer on the storefront, with a focus on visual craft, brand expression, and keeping the storefront looking fresh and commercially effective.

We are also excited for this person to embrace AI. You'll use AI tools to speed up your day-to-day workflow—handling routine formatting and generating assets so you have more time to spend on the actual creative craft that AI can't replicate.

If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in:

  • Helping design a site takeover for a new product launch (like adding a cameo from “Clammy” as a temporary avatar during our Splash Limited Edition).
  • Using AI tools to generate draft assets and format standard banners, saving yourself hours of manual resizing.
  • Collaborating with Growth Marketing to iterate on landing pages, making sure the design connects the ad content smoothly to the shop experience.
  • Partnering with the Product Designer to ensure your campaign placements fit nicely within the everyday storefront.
  • Updating standard campaign placements (banners, hero treatments, product callouts) to keep the site looking unmistakably Who Gives A Crap.
  • Sprinkling digital easter eggs across the site that reward curiosity (like hiding toilets across the site for a "Where's the Loo" Limited Edition campaign).

Let’s talk about you
You are a solid visual designer who understands that great digital design isn't just about looking good—it's about helping the customer find what they need. You have a great eye for typography and composition, and you're eager to learn how your designs impact metrics like conversion.

Here’s what we're hoping you'll bring to the table:

  • Visual Craft: You have a strong portfolio of digital work. You know how to take a campaign brief and apply it to digital surfaces while keeping the brand feeling consistent and high-quality.
  • Curiosity around AI: You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to speed up your production work, but you know that the final brand finish and quality control always stay with you.
  • Commercial Interest: You want to know why a design works. You're curious about how campaigns perform on site and are open to using customer insights to tweak your designs.
  • A Collaborative Mindset: You are a great team player. You listen well, adapt your communication style depending on who you are working with (marketing, engineering, etc.), and take constructive feedback in stride.
  • Time Management: You know how to juggle multiple tasks. Campaign work moves fast, so you are good at prioritizing your time, keeping the team updated on your progress, and flagging when you need help.

You give a crap
Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?
First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?
If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

raw.excerpt: Who are we? The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer.
raw.description:
Who are we?

The Motley Fool is a purpose-driven financial services company on a mission to make the world smarter, happier, and richer. For 30 years we’ve been helping people make better investment decisions through transparency, education, and Foolish fun. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team that values high-quality work, curiosity, and initiative. We care deeply about what we do, and we’re driven by the impact our work has on real people’s financial futures.

What does this team do?

The Fool is a place where a lot of fun and a lot of work happen quickly. Our Legal team helps us innovate while adhering to the laws and regulations that may affect all of the work and fun we do. We look to our lawyers to help us avoid fiascos, like [redacted] or [also redacted], but we especially want them to help us create great services for our members and the world.

What would you do in this role?

We’re looking for a strategic and entrepreneurial regulatory attorney to help guide the development, offer, and deployment of our products and services to the public, helping to shape the future of financial advice. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams and senior leaders across Product, Operations, Technology, and Compliance to serve as the primary legal advisor on our product offerings and development decisions . Comfortable taking on new and unique challenges in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, you will help us deliver trusted, tech-forward products while mitigating regulatory risk This is a high-impact role ideal for a lawyer who thrives at the intersection of innovation and regulation and can quickly assess risk, deliver pragmatic guidance, and enable responsible innovation at a rapid pace.

You will serve as the dedicated legal partner to our business colleagues throughout the full product development lifecycle — from ideation to launch and iteration — and help seamlessly integrate legal and compliance considerations into the way we build our products and services (one might say, “by design”).

No two days will look the same, but here’s a glimpse of what you’ll tackle:

  • Provide timely, business-grounded guidance on the legal and regulatory implications of new features and product lines offered by our businesses, from AI-powered tools to ETFs to research products.
  • Advise on applicable federal and state securities laws and regulations, including the Investment Advisers Act, as they relate to the Company's products and services.
  • Draft, review and facilitate the filing of regulatory documents.
  • Work with team members and external service providers to develop and implement compliance programs for new initiatives.
  • Draft legal disclosures, terms of service, and disclaimers to accompany the Company’s products and services.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams on regulatory compliance and implications of new features, including AI-enabled tools and automated financial communications.
  • Help identify and manage risk arising from marketing materials, disclosures, and member-facing communications.
  • Draft and review agreements relevant to product and operation activities.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, legal risks, and regulatory shifts — and educate internal stakeholders accordingly.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of legal experience with in-house and/or law firm experience (a combination of both is preferred), advising on product development within or adjacent to financial publishing, fintech, InvestTech, or other financial services environments.
  • Deep substantive and practical knowledge of investment management law, securities regulation and other applicable rules with emphasis on the Investment Advisers Act.
  • Familiarity with consumer financial protection regulations as applied to consumer-facing products and services.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate legal complexity into usable guidance for non-lawyers.
  • Direct experience advising on AI-enabled tools, automation systems, or personalization engines in a regulated context.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to balance risk mitigation with growth.
  • J.D. and active, good standing membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
Annual Pay Range
$260,000—$290,000 USD

By applying on this site, you acknowledge that The Motley Fool will be collecting the personal data you provide for our recruiting purposes. Please see our Applicant Privacy Notice for additional information about how we process, transfer, and store your data, including where that data is stored, and about any additional privacy rights you may have based on your jurisdiction.

raw.excerpt: Who is Credible? Credible is a leading U. S.  consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products.
raw.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the CRO (conversion rate optimization) of Credible's performance marketing landing pages and on-site funnel. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of performance marketing, product, and data - responsible for the experiments roadmap, landing page creation and optimization, and the testing infrastructure that helps Credible convert more of its paid traffic into qualified leads.

You will work directly with the Head of Performance Marketing and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and BI to run a continuous stream of CRO experiments. The ideal candidate combines strong product instincts with a quantitative mindset and a bias for shipping tests quickly over building perfect solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the experiments roadmap: maintain and prioritize a rolling backlog of CRO and landing page experiments across all verticals (Personal Loans, Student Loan Refi, Private Student Loans, Insurance, etc.); sequence tests by impact and dependency
  • Landing page creation & optimization using Credible’s CMS: collaborate with Design, Engineering, and Marketing to build and refine landing pages that boost Quality Score, load speed, conversion rates, and overall CMS capabilities
  • A/B test design and analysis: define hypotheses, success metrics, and minimum detectable effects for each experiment; own statistical analysis and present clear readouts with recommended next steps
  • Funnel performance ownership: track and own KPIs across the paid funnel — click-to-prequal rate, prequal-to-submit rate, submit-to-approval rate — and identify the highest-leverage drop-off points
  • Cross-functional execution: coordinate with Engineering on implementation timelines, with BI on instrumentation and event tracking, and with the SEM team on campaign alignment and Quality Score requirements
  • Performance reporting: build and maintain dashboards that give the marketing team real-time visibility into experiment status, landing page performance, and conversion trends
  • Conversion signal infrastructure: partner with the BI Engineer to improve offline conversion data quality and ensure experiment results feed back accurately into Google Ads bidding signals
  • User insight synthesis: use session recordings, heatmaps, funnel analytics, and qualitative feedback to generate testable hypotheses and maintain a prioritized insight backlog

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 5+ years in a Product Management role with a strong focus on conversion rate optimization, growth, or performance marketing products
  • CRO depth: hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests on landing pages or on-site funnels; familiarity with statistical significance, sample sizing, and experiment pitfalls
  • Marketing fluency: strong understanding of paid acquisition mechanics - Quality Score, landing page relevance, campaign-to-page alignment, and how conversion rate impacts paid channel economics
  • Technical collaboration: able to write clear specs, work closely with engineers on implementation, and understand front-end constraints without needing to code
  • Data skills: experienced with Google Analytics, Looker, or similar analytics tools
  • Speed and pragmatism: bias for launching imperfect tests quickly over waiting for perfect conditions; comfortable operating in a high-iteration environment
  • Communication: strong written English; able to present experiment results and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Education: Bachelor's degree; quantitative, engineering, or business background preferred

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience at a FinTech, financial marketplace, or lead-generation company
  • Familiarity with Google Ads Quality Score and how landing page experience affects paid channel performance
  • Experience with Strapi
  • Experience with tools like Optimizely, VWO, Google Optimize, or similar experimentation platforms
  • Background working with session replay tools (Hotjar, FullStory) and funnel analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude)
  • Prior experience in a performance marketing or growth role before moving into PM
  • Experience managing experiments across mobile and desktop simultaneously

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay ranges for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location, are listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents.

View more details about Credible Benefits

For high cost of labor markets such as but not limited to New York City and San Francisco:
$140,000—$165,000 USD
For all other US locations:
$120,000—$150,000 USD

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Who We Are

Our mission is to simplify the software delivery process so that DevOps and Platform Engineering teams can move fast, and deploy code effortlessly without the fear of breaking things.

The Akuity Platform enables teams to manage the development and deployment across hundreds – if not thousands – of Kubernetes clusters from a single control plane. Trusted by top companies around the globe, the Akuity Platform provides the only end-to-end GitOps platform for the enterprises.

Today, Argo CD is the third most popular project in the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) and is used by 70% of companies who are using Kubernetes in production. The list of Argo CD users includes companies like Intuit, BlackRock, Tesla, Major League Baseball, Peloton, and many more.

Meet the Team

We are growing our North American sales team and seeking a technical, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to help accelerate our expansion. You will join a small but impactful sales team and play a critical role in driving net-new business and growing existing accounts across the region.

We’re a team of self-starters with proven experience selling SaaS solutions in complex technical environments. You’ll develop territory plans, generate pipeline, and guide prospects through a consultative sales cycle, typically 6-8 months long.

Location: US & Canada - Remote - Eastern Standard Time or Atlantic Standard Time

Who You’ll Do

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new and expansion opportunities across North America territory.
  • Generate new business opportunities through multichannel outbound campaigns.
  • Develop a territory plan, including target accounts and pipeline generation strategies.
  • Research accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop relationships to drive opportunities.
  • Attend customer meetings and events, such as conferences and roadshows, approximately every other month.
  • Act as a customer advocate and liaison to Akuity’s engineering team for feature requests.
  • Leverage sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to qualify, advance, and forecast opportunities accurately.
  • Map technical needs to business outcomes and clearly articulate ROI.
  • Manage all activities and pipeline in HubSpot.

Who You Are

  • Effective communicator with excellent listening, presentation, and writing skills.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a high-energy, collaborative environment.

Nice to Have

Why Akuity?

At Akuity, we believe open-source software is the most impactful way to build lasting technology. We founded this company to advocate for Argo, share our expertise, and be a trusted partner to its users.

Our culture is grounded in humility, authenticity, and diversity. We value people from different backgrounds and paths in life. raw.description:
About Us

Gridline is here to redefine how private markets operate, making them faster, smarter, and more accessible. We are setting a new standard by building the Turnkey Alternatives Management Platform (TAMP) to help wealth managers run private market programs at scale. As a ledger-native system of record, Gridline provides a single source of truth that tracks the entire investment lifecycle down to the transaction layer, enabling RIAs, family offices, and private banks to manage their private markets business in one place.

Our team brings deep experience across both enterprise technology and alternative investments to build the infrastructure layer the industry has always lacked. Backed by an $18.5M Series A led by FINTOP, we are creating the systems and structuring the data required to define the next generation of private market investing. Are you up to the challenge?

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Sr. Account Executive to own and scale revenue growth within the Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) channel. As a senior, quota-carrying seller, you will be responsible for executing Gridline’s go-to-market motion, closing new business, and expanding existing accounts within the private markets ecosystem.

This is an externally facing role for an experienced seller who understands the specific nuances of how RIAs buy technology that serves as the core engine to build, launch, run, and manage private market vehicles. You must be able to navigate complex stakeholder groups - including CEOs, CCOs, CIOs, COOs, and Principals - positioning Gridline as a long-term platform partner committed to their growth rather than just a vendor.

This role offers fully remote flexibility across any major US metropolitan area (excluding NYC), with an uncapped, wide-open territory that gives you the freedom to build, scale, and succeed from day one.

This is an amazing opportunity to join Gridline at this inflection point, reporting directly to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO).

In this role you will...

  • Drive Revenue: Own net-new and expansion revenue for your assigned territory, with full accountability for pipeline health, bookings, and deals won.
  • Build Pipeline: Generate and advance a high-quality pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, inbound opportunities, and your existing network of referrals.
  • Close Complex Deals: Personally manage deals from discovery to contract execution, engaging with multiple C-suite stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Expand Accounts: Drive multi-product adoption across the Gridline platform to maximize customer lifetime value and territory revenue.
  • Operationalize Growth: Maintain rigorous CRM discipline and partner closely with Marketing and Product teams to refine messaging and support demand generation.
  • Represent the Brand: Act as a face of Gridline at industry events and client meetings, simplifying complex fintech concepts into clear value propositions for RIAs and their clients.

You have...

  • Experience: At least 5 years of complex enterprise sales experience (ideally selling a fintech and/or wealthtech SaaS product to RIAs, family offices etc.).
  • Ability to Travel: Ability to travel 15 - 20% within your assigned territory for client meetings and industry conferences.
  • Education: Ideally a bachelor's or equivalent in a related field (finance, economics etc.).
  • Location: This role is 100% remote within assigned territory with a strong preference for a major regional financial market.

We offer...

  • Impact: The opportunity to join a Series A fintech at a high-growth inflection point.
  • Mission-Driven Work: The ability to revolutionize the private markets space and build the industry’s infrastructure layer.
  • Elite Collaboration: A tight-knit team of experienced operators and builders who are passionate about scaling startups.
  • Ownership: A high-autonomy environment where you are encouraged to take ownership and solve complex problems.
  • Full Suite of Benefits: Competitive salary, equity, and flexible PTO, plus robust medical, dental, and vision coverage.

Gridline is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
Lucidworks is leading digital transformation for some of the world's biggest retailers, financial services firms, manufacturers, and B2B commerce organizations. We believe that the core to a great digital experience starts with search and browse. Our Deep Learning technology captures user behavior and utilizes machine learning to connect people with the products, content, and information they need. Brands including American Airlines, Lenovo, Red Hat, and Cisco Systems rely on Lucidworks' suite of products to power commerce, customer service, and workplace applications that delight customers and empower employees. Lucidworks believes in the power of diversity and inclusion to help us do our best work. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and welcome talent across a full range of backgrounds, orientation, origin, and identity in an inclusive and non-discriminatory way.
Please note: To ensure a fair and efficient process for all applicants, we kindly ask that you refrain from direct outreach to our hiring managers or team members. All communication should go through the official application portal. We will review your application carefully and reach out to you if your qualifications match our needs. We appreciate your interest in Lucidworks!

About the Role

As a Search Engineer on our Technical Support team, you'll be a trusted technical partner to our customers, helping them get the most out of Lucidworks Fusion and resolving the issues that stand between them and a great search experience. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engineering and Customer Success to run down product defects, performance issues, and feature requests, and you'll help shape the product by surfacing what you're hearing from the field.

This role rewards sharp problem-solving, careful attention to detail, and a genuine understanding of search technology. You'll move comfortably between deeply technical conversations and plain-language explanations for non-technical stakeholders, and you'll bring real empathy to every interaction, because behind every ticket is a person trying to get their job done.

This role provides primary support to our U.S. government customers, so it does come with a citizenship requirement below. It's fully remote and will stay that way. We're ideally looking for someone based on the West Coast or who is comfortable working hours aligned with the Pacific time zone.

What you’ll do

    • Field incoming questions and help customers configure Lucidworks Fusion and its components, and understand how to get the most from the product's features

    • Troubleshoot complex search issues across Lucene, Solr, and related distributed systems

    • Write clear, reusable knowledge base articles that help the broader customer base solve similar issues on their own

    • Spot opportunities to bring customers additional value through follow-on products and services

    • Relay high-value use cases and customer feedback to Product and Engineering so it shapes what we build next

    • Collaborate across teams to diagnose and resolve critical, high-stakes issues

    • Participate in a 24/7/365 on-call rotation, including weekends and holidays

What we're looking for

    • U.S. citizenship, required due to government contracts

    • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Lucene/Solr or comparable search technologies (e.g., Elasticsearch, OpenSearch)

    • 3+ years of professional experience in a customer-facing, level 2–3 technical support role

    • A bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering or Computer Science, preferred

    • Experience working in a technical support CRM (Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar)

    • Clear, confident written and verbal communication with customers over email and phone

    • Proficiency in Java, plus a scripting language such as Python, Perl, or Ruby

    • Comfort on Unix/Linux systems: command-line navigation, file permissions, system logs, scripting, and basic networking

    • Working proficiency with Kubernetes and containerized deployments

      • Bonus points for:

      • Exposure to related open-source projects or other commercial search technologies

      • Experience in enterprise search, e-commerce, or business intelligence

      • Familiarity with machine learning, data science, or Gen AI concepts (embeddings, vector search, RAG)

      • Hands-on experience with a public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

      • Startup experience

Our Stack

    • Apache Lucene/Solr, ZooKeeper, Spark, Kafka, Ray, Helm

    • Java, Python, Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub, Grafana

    • Zendesk, Jira

Lucidworks believes in the power of diversity and inclusion to help us do our best work. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and welcome talent across a full range of backgrounds, orientation, origin, and identity in an inclusive and non-discriminatory way. Applicants receive consideration based on the relevant talents, skills, and experiences they offer to our company.
Thank you for your interest and we look forward to learning more about you.

Note to third party recruiters:

We appreciate your interest in our job opportunities. However, we kindly request that third-party recruiters and staffing agencies refrain from contacting us regarding these positions. We prefer to work directly with candidates and do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate referrals from third-party recruiters or agencies. Unsolicited resumes and referrals will become the property of Lucidworks, and no fee will be paid should we hire a candidate whose resume was sent unsolicited.

raw.title: Agile Coach (FTC)
raw.excerpt: TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.
raw.description:
TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

About The Role

We're looking for an Agile Coach to enable our Product Engineering squads to work more effectively together across the full product development lifecycle - from problem definition and discovery, through to delivery, release and outcome measurement. You’ll bring consistency and rigour to how individual squads work at every stage, and own the consistency of how those squads plan, visualise progress, and share their work.

We're looking for someone with solid, hands-on coaching experience who's not afraid to roll up their sleeves and get stuck into squad ways of working and drive impact.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Product Designers, Software Engineers, Data Analysts, and leadership across Product Engineering. Rather than spreading thin across every team at once, you'll typically go deep - spending an extended period (for example, a quarter) embedded with one or two squads at a time, building the relationships and trust needed to drive real, measurable change before moving focus elsewhere.

What you'll do

  • Coach squads to embed effective agile and product-centric practices helping teams adopt dual-track ways of working so research and discovery run effectively alongside delivery.

  • Guide teams as they mature their delivery practices and adopt product-centred planning and prioritisation approaches.

  • Coach teams on outcomes over output, helping them understand whether what they shipped actually had the desired customer and business impact.

  • Facilitate team-level meetings (refinement, retrospectives, planning) as required as part of team coaching.

  • Help drive our shift left quality approach.

  • Eliminate blockers through creative conversation and become a trusted advisor to the teams you work with.

  • Offer insight on which metrics best measure team effectiveness and how to improve them over time.

  • Act as a catalyst for change and experimentation, embedding an agile mindset without imposing a one-size-fits-all solution.

  • Coach teams to build and sustain the habit of keeping their roadmaps, delivery plans, and progress clearly visualised spotting where consistency is slipping across squads and working with the relevant people to close the gap.

  • Own the cadence of cross-squad sessions (e.g. show & tells, team learnings) - organising, running, and iterating on them so good practice and information travel beyond a single team.

  • Spot where AI can genuinely speed teams up, and build that into their everyday ways of working.

Requirements

  • Experience working as an Agile Coach with cross-functional, self-organising Agile teams.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, customer-centric scale-ups.
  • Experience working in a remote-first, high-performance company.
  • Deep understanding of Agile and Lean thinking, values and principles.
  • Hands-on experience applying a variety of frameworks and methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, DevOps and XP, and a track record of combining these approaches effectively.
  • Experience teaching a wide range of Agile practices such as user story mapping, event storming, example mapping, and slicing.
  • Experience coaching teams on “outcomes over output” and the adoption of continuous product discovery and delivery with a track record of helping teams improve discovery and quality practices, not just delivery speed.
  • Comfortable holding people accountable to agreed team practices - working with relevant team members to close gaps against those standards..
  • A progressive understanding of emerging Agile practices and concepts, including how AI is changing how teams work.
  • A servant-leader who gets a kick out of helping others to succeed and grow.

You'll feel like a fish out of water if:

We know this isn't what you'd see in most job ads - but TrustedHousesitters isn't most companies.

Trust, transparency, and honest feedback aren't just things we say; they're genuinely how we operate, every day. So rather than leaving you guessing if things don't work out, we'd rather give you what you need to make a great decision upfront about whether this opportunity is right for you.

With that in mind, here are a few things worth considering before you hit apply:

  • You're more comfortable as a delivery or project manager than a coach - if your instinct is to manage dependencies and chase updates rather than challenge teams and remove the dependency altogether, this isn't that role

  • You need everything mapped out before you start - this is a brand new role here, still being shaped, and you'll have a hand in defining it as you go

  • You've only coached in large, rigid or enterprise environments - we're a scrappy, five-or-six-team setup, not a heavily-processed org with the infrastructure that comes with it

  • You lean on frameworks, certifications, or "doing Scrum by the book" over understanding the why - we care far more about mindset than ticking off methodology or chasing a SAFE certification

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family

  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits

  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan

  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan

  • Specsavers eyecare scheme

  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions

  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident

  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start

  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe

  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year

  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth

  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)

  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually

  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly

  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters

  • £500 recruitment referral bonus
